#1 How can you choose/create a roadmap for a career in IT Industry?

It’s not what you achieve, it’s what you overcome. That’s what defines your career.” — Carlton Fisk

Forming a roadmap to what you want for your career especially in IT is based on 3 things,

  • How skilled you are in the things that you know.
  • What is the range of technologies and tools you know or can learn in the given period?
  • How much clear communication you do with the customer in your industry to make sure all the pre-requisites are collected before starting up micro projects (Chunks of tasks inside projects mostly referred to as milestones in some cases).

In this fast-growing world where the people who change the world keep on increasing every day, those above 3 points always come in the scope. Simply you can say this as, Knowledgeable, Adaptable & Communicable.

#2 Is it possible to start a business even while you are working?

“Find out what you like doing best and get someone to pay you for doing it.” — Katherine Whitehorn

Yes, absolutely possible! To start a business, it is very important to understand the timing of the idea that you are going to implement. Don't rush, take it steady and spend at least 10-min every day planning your business for 3 years and that is almost 10,000 minutes. This will give you a kickstart about how exactly you can turn your idea into a product and product to a stream of income.

As we know, some tools are available for free to set up your business on the Internet. Start with zero and incrementally immerse yourself in the idea of starting a business. List down your ideas every day and mark the most efficient often.

Try filtering out the idea and list the pros and cons of it. Once this process is completed, plan the development of the tool if it is required. Again, planning the product development should start from zero where you learn a new approach to build the product using fewer commercials. Use your salary at least 2K per month and save it for your business.

Once product development is done, start learning about business, strategy, and finance models.

Once you have a revenue model or an idea of how to turn the product into a revenue stream, you need to figure out a way to get profits for your business.

To decide the profit margins, always remember to set very low margins at the start, not more than 200% for what you invest in your product or service. As you expand the business, try catching investors (This is where investors or equity comes in not before this stage). Getting investors will be very easy if you are making profits already. Start with Round A and offer a 10% stake to the investor not more than that - This puts you in the commanding position.

As I saw businesses, they always need a good team of people who are in there for the same goals as yours. Be very careful and specific in trusting people. Be ruthless in firing too. Always keep your loved ones with you. Consider the right reasons to persuade investors. Be the one who holds most of the company's share like 60% to 70%.

This is how to start planning and building a company while you are working. Never forget the company you work for.

#3 How can you keep learning every day when you put under pressure in your job or the business?

“The beautiful thing about learning is that nobody can take it away from you.”― B.B. King

Learning new technologies, culture, language or a subject is an art of living life fully. If you don't let yourself learn new things, there is no point in being existent in this world. We, humans, are blessed with infinite potential to achieve anything we want. In this new generation, access to most of the information is given to everyone via the Internet.

Follow this 10-min rule every day as long as you can. Simple learning every day and give time to know new things. Small chuck of 10-min, learn something new and make a note of it. Hardly it will take around 15 mins for you but when u look at the bigger picture say 3 years. It is almost equal to 10,000 mins.

Imagine in the last 3 years if you would have spent 10,000 mins learning something, how much you would be knowing right now. Amazing, isn't it? With that much practice with very small effort, you can land anywhere you want. If you think of the next 10 years, it is almost 45,000 mins. Imagine, where you will be after 10 years if you follow the 10-min rule.

#4 How can you write the things you learned so that others like you can use the same guide?

“Documentation is a love letter that you write to your future self “— Damian Conway

In this ever-growing fast-paced world, documentation plays an important role. Even if it is an underrated skill, as per the research, each person learning or understanding new things assigned by the company spends 30% of the time (2.5 hours/day) researching it.

Based on the statistic, a worker spends 2.5 hours per day, looking for information. Assuming now an average yearly salary of 80,000 $, the inability to find and retrieve documents costs an organization, that employs 1000 workers, $ 25 million per year.

Hence it is important to write down every research with clear documentation. To record your research there are 3 simple things u can follow:

  • Always start with your favorite tool to write (Digital/Traditional)
  • Take 10-Mins to 15-Mins to write every day about the research you did. (Apart from 10-min learning rule)
  • Once the writing is complete, take time to review it before publishing it.

I. Always start with your favorite tool to write (Digital/Traditional)

Writing every day can be trickery. I have been there. Being consistent in life is very challenging especially in the activities that will take you higher. Writing every day will improve your ability to think and thrive in this ever-changing world. To make it easier, start with few words on a sheet of paper or even you can take notes in your favorite tool (for me it is Evernote).

Set the schedule every day to write something, anything you wish to write. It may be some messed up words or you want to write the story of that day or you want to write about the person you love (I do this frequently).

No need of publishing anything yet. Just write and write. If you don’t want to read it again or want to throw it into the dust bin, it is cool as well. Whatever it is, just write.

II. Take 10-Mins to 15-Mins to write every day about the research you did. (Apart from 10-min learning rule)

Anyone must grow in this world to have consistency. As I usually discuss the 10-Min rule of learning, there is one more rule we can follow for writing i.e. 15-min writing rule each day. Help yourself and write something to get into the picture of planning.

III. Once the writing is complete, take time to review it before publishing it.

Write what you learned today in the end and publish it on your social media or in your blogs. This practice will make you good at documenting your work where someday when others see your notes, it will help them to understand your research. Reviewing your work before publishing or proofread your notes.

#5 Why share information about what you know in the first place?

“Innovation comes only from readily and seamlessly sharing information rather than hoarding it” — Tom Peters

You might have heard about this, what you share or document your work, will lasts generations. If our ancestors hadn’t found a way to store information or the research they did in their lifetime, we never would have got a chance to land on the moon or even thinking beyond our planet where it was believed that earth is the center of the universe.

As long as we write about our research and findings, for others it will serve as a Kickstarter and not experiment from scratch. This is the major philosophy behind the improvement of technology and open source projects. In programming, nothings need to be built from scratch these days. We always have templates for everything.

So, to summarize, preserving records is very much important for humanity to move forward. We are code breakers and our potential is infinite. One day I am sure that we will reach the point where we can live anywhere we want and there will be zero poverty exists.

Follow me on LinkedIn or in Medium for further updates about my work. You can also visit my GitHub profile to see about my technical doings.

title: Adding TLS Certificate to Dynatrace Cluster Nodes
description: From getting free SSL certificate to adding them to managed cluster nodes and mapping to primary domain
imageAlt: A certificate seal and protective shield connecting securely to three small server towers by fine ink lines; TLS certificates for cluster nodes.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Yesterday, I searched all over the place on the internet about how to add TLS certificates to Dynatrace cluster nodes and make a single domain to route through multiple nodes in case of any failure in the primary node. As we already know that data between nodes in Dynatrace will be distributed across multiple nodes if it exists and a failover mechanism is triggered if there is a failure in a node or two.

I didn’t find a single article that explains this hence I thought of writing my experiments in my blog. For those who are new, SSL/TLS certificates are security certificates for a website where it tells the user to enter passwords/sensitive data into the site they are in. If a website is having a TLS certificate, it means it uses HTTPS protocol instead of HTTP. This means whatever data you enter inside that site is protected with some security measures. Also, the domain is trusted by the third-party authorities which we call the Certificate Authority (CA).

CAs are helping the internet to be the place where user can safely share their information with the company or the website with peace of mind without having to worry about attacks in the middle of stealing their sensitive data. This is done by CAs by issuing a certificate for each domain and recognizing it. If the domain is having a valid certificate, the web browser displays that domain with a lock symbol telling that this site is having a certificate that is trusted by CA and you can share your information on this site. What happens in the backed? This is the topic of another session. In this article, I like to tell you some of the key pointers to be noted while installing SSL certificates in Dynatrace cluster nodes.

For those new to Dynatrace, the cluster nodes concept comes in the Dynatrace Managed deployment model where all the data that Dynatrace OneAgents collects will be residing in the data center of the organization and not in the Dynatrace cloud. Usually, as a Dynatrace ACE consultant, we recommend everyone to have at least 3 nodes in their cluster to prevent failure or 100% data loss.

Each node will be having its own set of IPs (Public and Private). Due to security reasons, organizations prefer to have only private IPs in their nodes. Since a lot of sensitive data is captured and stored in those nodes, all the communication must be secure. In Dynatrace we take security very seriously and protecting our customer’s data is our first preference. The first step to being secure on the web is, encrypting the communication even inside the data center as well as throughout the Internet.

Note: This article holds good for those who want to add their own domain names by disabling the default address that is provided by Dynatrace. (Disable the SSL certificate management)

Let’s get started

Let’s get started on how do we do that and what are the points we need to keep in mind while applying certificated to cluster nodes.

Pre-requisites

  1. Dynatrace Managed Cluster with a license
  2. At least 3 Cluster Nodes
  3. Admin access to the cluster
  4. SSL certificates (Multi-Domain or 4 Single domain certificates)
  5. Access to the domain’s DNS record.

Once the above pre-requisites are satisfied, let’s go ahead and start the drill. I will discuss each step starting from having your own domain connected to adding your subdomain to cluster nodes and then mapping them to your domain’s CNAME record.

Scenario:

To start our journey, understanding the current scope is important and in this section, I will brief you on what exactly we are doing and which scenario we are in. I have a Dynatrace managed instance with 3 cluster nodes in it. I purchased a new domain from GoDaddy and also created an account in ZeroSSL for getting SSL certificates for the domain. In my scenario, I want to use the domain I purchased and add the subdomain as lab.dt-transform.com to access Dynatrace managed. Along with that, I also need n01.lab.dt-transform.comn02.lab.dt-transform.com & n03.lab.dt-transform.com to access the same website but it should hit 3 other respective nodes where n01 for node 1 and n03 to node 3. Along with the accessibility, all of these domains should have SSL certificates as well. One use case here for using SSL/TLS here is, we cannot access sensitive session replay data in Dynatrace unless the domain you are visiting is accessed through HTTPS protocol.

#1 Creating Multi-domain certificate

Now, before changing DNS records of the domain, let’s generate certificates for all of the mentioned domains using ZeroSSL (It is free to generate certificates but you need to upgrade to a basic plan to generate multiple or unlimited single domain certificates). Create certificates for each domain and in my case, I am using multiple domain certificates. Where I am generating certificates for all 3 no1, no2, and n03 domains by combining each of them with lab.dt-transform.com. This makes certification generation like this,

  • Certificate One — n01.lab.dt-transform.com & lab.dt-transform.com
  • Certificate Two — n02.lab.dt-transform.com & lab.dt-transform.com
  • Certificate Three — n03.lab.dt-transform.com & lab.dt-transform.com

You need a pro account to generate multiple domain certificates. The certificate which we generate is 90-day certificates where we can renew them every 90-days indefinite times. Follow the steps that are shown in the ZeroSSL portal and generate the certificate which will contain 3 files if you download using the default format. These files will contain, Private Key (It mustn’t be shared with anyone), Public Key, and CA Bundle (Certificate Chain is optional).

Note: Certificate generation depends on the network team where you can instruct your customer regarding the same and get you the files in a default certificate format. I am using my own lab and have all rights to do it here so I am following the steps of generating a certificate here.

Once you generate certificate for all domains, you need to apply each certificate in each cluster nodes.

#2 Installing certificates to cluster nodes

Now, login to Dynatrace CMC and go to deployment status and under cluster nodes, you will see the list of nodes that are installed.

Click on the icon that is in the details icon on any one of the nodes and got to configure option and Edit SSL certificate. 3 new fields will open as shown in the below screenshot.

In each of those fields please select the files and entry will automatically be populated. Make sure you use the n01 certificate to cluster node 1 and n02 to cluster node 2. Extract the certificate that you downloaded in step 1 and select the files for

  • Private Key select private.key file
  • Public key certificate select certificate.crt
  • Certificate chain select ca_bundle.crt

Save the changes and it should reflect as shown below, for cluster node 1. You can see the domain name with the certificate issuer name along with its expiry date.

Once the changes are saved, please follow the same steps for rest of the 2 nodes.

#3 Updating DNS A records and pointing sub-domains to cluster node IP addresses

Congratulations!! You have completed the tough part of applying SSL to cluster nodes. Now following steps will ensure that you route the traffic to those domains. In my case, I am going to GoDaddy and in there I am editing manage DNS settings in it but in your case, it can be a network team of domain team who is responsible for DNS records update in domain provider services. Please get the IPs of Cluster nodes and this might me public IP or might be private too depends on the security level they are exposing their cluster too. Please follow these instructions below,

  • In my case, I am using the public IP of the cluster nodes.
  • In manage DNS, add records in such a way that each node is pointing to its own IP. E.g. n01.lab.dt-transform should be pointed to cluster node 1.
  • So, add A name records so that all nodes are pointing to their respective IPs.
  • As a part of the test now you can visit each of these domains to check the traffic is routing through each of these nodes and observing they are serving through the HTTPS protocol. Even if you use HTTP, it will be redirected to HTTPS.

#4 Pointing the main domain to all these sub-domains by updating A records.

Now the hard part is done. We need to route traffic to the main domain and also apply a failover mechanism when cluster node 1 is not accessible or down, it should automatically switch to another node for seamless access. Usually, this happens in a round-robin fashion. To do that we need to apply A records in our DNS entries to ensure high availability.

Here our task is to make sure the same URL works for all nodes. Hence, we need to point all cluster node IPs to the main domain lab.dt-transform.com. To do that, simple update A records as shown below.

You’re set!!! Once you update your records, it might take a couple of minutes to reflect. Try visiting the site and now you can see the page is reflecting with HTTPS.

#5 Update public endpoint in Dynatrace and change it to main domain

Finally, you can now update the endpoint in Dynatrace which is useful in problem notification and notification emails. Go to CMC > Settings > Public endpoints > change the URL to https://lab.dt-transform.com

Conclusion

The above steps and activity we performed are basically holding good if you have an experience in Dynatrace and also in some of the concepts on how technology works like networking, IP, DNS, OSI layer, Communication protocols. If you want to know about the topics that are mentioned in the steps please checkout help articles related to them below,

  1. SSL/TLS
  2. Certificate Authorities
  3. Certificate Chain
  4. Dynatrace Managed
  5. Open Source Certificate Providers
  6. Domain Name System
  7. IP Routing Table
  8. Browser Security

I hope this is useful for you. Have a great time ahead and all the best for the implementation. Happy reading and Happy learning!!! Signing off for now. Until next time.

With a smile and regards.

title: A Spiritual Book That Talks About Science of Life
description: Karma — A Yogi’s Guide To Crafting Your Destiny by Sadhguru explains us about the technology that is responsible for ultimate creation.
imageAlt: Threads of action weave into a simple wheel around one seed, with a quiet open book; a reflective reading of karma and responsibility.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
There are 3 parts in the book to start with and each part tries to answers some of the questions we have on Karma. Karma for those who don’t know is simply called action. When we step into milestones in our life everything depends on certain things we did or we do in life and these actions are governed by our inner mechanism. Often we confuse ourselves that we are governed by life and it is entirely wrong. Everything in this universe is built on the same elements that our physical body is built on. The whole book is having 17 sutras which can be anchors for our living with joy.

Part One

The first part of the book explains the definition of Karma. How it is made up of. Our body is made up of 8 types of memories and each of them has its own nature. Our cells in the body have the capability to store a million times more memory than what our brain could store or accumulate. Everything you do each breath you respire will leave a mark or tendencies which will turn into vasanas (imprints we leave upon every interaction we do with nature). These are all stitched together in a physical, mental, and energetic way written in the book. It requires a bit of concentration to understand it thoroughly but it is interesting.

Sanchita, Prarabdha & Agami are the main types of Karma which we deal with in our creation where Sanchita is the warehouse, Prarabdha Karma is allotted karma for one’s lifetime. Agami Karma is something that we accumulate in real-time.

Part Two

The second part of the book explains the details of how to burn allotted Karma in 3 main ways i.e Physical, Mentally, Spiritually. Physical activities that are performed without expecting results are the catalysts to burn our karma. Mentally sitting still and just look at things as they are without comparison is one way to burn karma. As spiritual seekers, we can simply experience enlightenment in every way of life and one good example of that is understanding the cosmic balance and for that, we can do practices such as Isha Kriya which establishes a boundary around us. Attaining Mahasamadhi is an unfathomable ecstasy of boundless existence.

The very interesting part came when Sadhguru explains with examples and relates to the real world to understand how we can experience life. Thinking about dissolving karma itself accumulates more karma. One basic way to make sure that we dissolve karma is by living conscious life in every decision we make. An unconscious living will always lead to the accumulation of karma.

Part Three

Part Three is about total understanding and FAQs from the questioner. Sadhguru explains how we need to treat karma and whether our understanding suffices to be the masters of our life. How exactly animals are different than us in accumulating karma. He also explains that having free will is like a blessing but most of us consider that as suffering. We need to be the drivers of our life instead of letting karma drive us. This is when we all can collectively accumulate karma that helps our society to grow toward goodness.

Conclusion

Overall, this book opens the reader’s eye and makes the reader share the knowledge with others. Taking control of life is always an internal struggle and we all should remember that external forces are always act on us but everything we are made from the elements that created the universe. Unlocking the mystery is all inside us when we reach the deepest memory, we can understand the evolution process of life. Karma is a life force that keeps the physical existence. Without it physical bodies will not exist — At least as I understood — The universe is one good space where all energies will act upon to create forces that we today call matters and bodies.

This book is definitely not a one-time read. To understand it completely, try to read at least twice. This is not a spiritual book. This is the book of energy that we interact with daily in our lives. I hope we will collectively attain the consciousness to go beyond. But first, understanding our internal energies of physical, mental, and spiritual bodies is necessary.

Let me know your thoughts as well. Happy Reading!!!

title: Getting Started with Azure (AZ-900 Exam)
description: Microsoft Certification: Azure Fundamentals (It can be your foundation for learning something big)
imageAlt: A small cloud balanced on three strong foundation blocks, with a short staircase and an unmarked study notebook; learning Azure fundamentals.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Recently, I took a basic certification exam from Microsoft and I passed it. Getting a Microsoft certification was my dream and finally, I got a chance to start with one. AZ-900 is an exam that talks about Microsoft Azure services and capabilities. It is also called Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals.

In this article, I am going to talk about how did I do it. What are the best practices you can follow if you are looking to pass the exam and at last, the next steps as well? I hope this will help you and upon following these 5 simple steps, I am sure you will get certified.

Step 1: Official Material from Microsoft learn

Link: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals — Learn | Microsoft Docs

In this step, you will be learning through 6 parts of the syllabus covered to complete the exam. AZ-900 is a very basic exam to learn about the fundamentals of Microsoft Azure. Before going in to take an exam please follow the steps with these preparation materials.

The first step is always to read even if you don’t like reading blogs or documentation. Because reading will set your mind for better things to come next up. In this documentation, you will find the collection of videos along with written materials to help you understand step by step starting from Cloud computing. The good thing here is, they have a sandbox environment to help you understand how these services work in a learn by doing method. There are 6 parts each one of them covers each topic that is related to the AZ-900 exam. It is easy and you can spend 15 mins a day studying this material to understand.

Step 2: YouTube Video

Link: AZ-900 Azure Fundamentals Hints and Tips — YouTube

Next up you can do this parallelly with step 1. This is an hour video to give you a complete overview of Azure and how it is created. It starts from Azure tenant and its management groups which is the starting point of Azure. It extends up again to the cloud service models and what are the Azure services belongs to which models (SaaS, PaaS). There are several videos on YouTube but this one I felt better and you too can understand about basic terms of Azure and its services. You can also watch this video more than once to understand it better.

Step 3: LinkedIn Learning (Microlearning)

Link: Azure certification for advancement (linkedin.com)

To go through this course you may need a LinkedIn premium subscription unless this course is available to you for free or even if you are in a 30-day trial already. This is a very nice overview course out there and is been recommended by 1000s of individuals. In this, Sharon explained each of the 6 categorized that is covered in the exam. No need for hands-on. Just sit and listen to what she says and I am sure you will understand the exam topics.

Topics include Overview, Cloud Concepts, Azure Core Services, Core Solutions and Management Tools, General & Network Security, Identity, Governance, Privacy and Compliance, Cost Management, and Service SLAs. Take some time to understand each of them and the best thing to do is sit back and relax then listen. Observe and relate concepts with the experience you have in life.

Step 4: Practice Questions

Link: Ace Microsoft AZ-900 Certification with Actual Questions | ExamTopics

Unless you have contributor’s access you cannot view all 204 questions in this portal but still, you can go up to 100 to 120 questions. Which I feel is more than enough to crack the exam. Keep this in mind, you need more than 700 points to pass the exam. These questions include all the topics that are covered along with answers with good explanations.

Step 5: Take the exam and get certified

Final and the most important step is to schedule the exam and pass it. Questions will vary from 30 to 50 depending on factors that Microsoft decides. Proctor will be seeing you throughout the exam and there will not be vocal communication. All things will be communicated through live chat. Once you pass the exam within 2 hours you will receive the acclaim badge and the certificate can be downloaded from the dashboard.

Next Steps:

Completing the certificate is simply not enough if you are a lover of learning skills or if you want to move up your career. You got to follow the next steps of becoming an Azure Developer Associate or Administrator Associate. It is good to keep learning and face new challenges that is what makes life interesting, isn’t it?

Stay tuned for more updates from my side and I am happy to listen to your story as well. Thanks for reading and I hope you will get certified. Let’s use technology for good and getting a basic certification can be a good start. Not to get a job or show off the skills but to help others build better software.

title: Procrastination of Deep Thoughts: Point of Being Happy in Life
description: Part 2: Being Happy and Ways to Change Life for you and for Others
imageAlt: A pebble settles into still water and its tangled reflections become calm concentric ripples under a soft sun; finding happiness beyond overthinking.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
In the previous article, I discussed questions that will arise when we start to think about the categories in life that we are in. There are 100s of categories we can set our mind to and eventually it will become 1000s. As long as we procrastinate or be uncertain about whatever happening in our life, we will never get a chance to move forward in life. We don’t need anybody to pull you back, we will keep doing that to ourselves easily. This deep thinking about the topics that don’t make sense to live your life happily is like a toxic substance, killing life and happiness.

In this part 2 of the series, we will discuss the common problems that we are all facing and stuck in life as human beings at a young age. The list of problems is infinite and we can list all of them daily but yet they increase. You might be wondering where I am coming from. Let me tell you a small story of mine, I have friends and I had many best friends in my life and the people in those places changed and got replaced one after the other. People fade away but the place that you have for the particular relationships will get replaced.

For example, from 2014 to 2019 I had 2 best friends in my life, and maybe one best friendship was started to become the love of my life. At last, those friends parted ways with me. That doesn’t mean friendship got ended in my life. Fortunately, now I have 3 best friends instead of 2. As long as we don’t practice acceptance in life, we are miserable. You gotta accept life as it is and find your way of happiness. If you wait for something or someone to change for you, trust me then you are a frog in the well. That’s not gonna happen. Maybe if you find the perfect ideal partner for your life — It’s just bullshit thinking. There is nothing called perfect in this world. There is no perfection. We all just learn from our past and we evolve to become better every day in life that’s it.

Let’s see about life and happiness in simple yet powerful 4 ways:

  1. Turn your shit in.
  2. Allow others to help you or suggest you (Have a mentor or let someone into your core).
  3. Be happy if challenges are coming your way.
  4. If you are in love, don’t get attached to the person get attached to the relationship.

#1: Turn your shit in

Life is miserable but yet it is beautiful. Live every day and die slowly. One or the other day you will so why worry about that when you don’t know your expiry date. Eventually, everything falls in one place and we all share the same fate as all other creatures — Death. As Sadhguru says, “Death is not a destination, it is a process.”

So we all have limited time and very limited people we can meet in the process. We all know we live an average of about 20000 days. For example, even if we try hard and meet 10 people every day, we cannot cover 1% of the world throughout our lifetime. This is a staggering stat to consider and keep reminding ourselves that how huge this life pool is. So in this very limited time create something huge for yourself. I know it is easy to say and difficult to execute — If you are thinking this now, let me ask you one thing what other choice do you have in life? Do you have the ability to change things or did you attain one? If the answer is no, continue reading.

Remember this one thing in life always, problems will be there for everyone, It is what makes us strong and bold. If you keep thinking that you are unfortunate in life, consider the people who have limited food to eat each day and fewer clothes to wear. At least you have a house to live and parents to love and friends to care for you. If you are not grateful for what you have then you will never be happy in life. This is just the dogma and the trap you are living in. If you are in this situation, tell yourself that you are already trapped in your own boundary or walls. Break it! Turn your shit in.

Life is huge and you are the one who can live your own life there is no substitute for the game you are playing, you gotta play all by yourself. Others might give you an assist but you should be the one to score a goal and beat the goalie or dribble your way past defenders (Consider as challenges in life). Don’t carry the weight on your shoulders, if you are willing to pass it, help will come on its way. There are no shortcuts for you.

#2: Allow others to help you or suggest you (Have a mentor or let someone in to your core)

It is difficult for some of us out there to lead lives because of some self-respect and ego problems. If someone closer to them say or suggests anything for their own wellness they might feel that the whole world is there to speak against them. Remember this, “People scold you because they care for you. Strangers will never care for you no matter what. There are 7 other billion people in life and not everyone will care for you or even know you at all.”

It is not so bad to ask for help from others who care for you and let them in your life add their mind to your problems and suggest you a better way to come out of it or even bring you out of it. If you don’t trust how you can trust the things that are all happening around you? Tomorrow a solar flare may hit our planet and we all may perish, right? Do you have a guarantee that it will not happen? Likewise, people will not come to our lives with guarantees and stay for long. They just simply come and go and on the way, they will help us to be a better version of ourselves.

If we are facing trouble from opening up to someone or anyone, it is better to follow certain steps to make ourselves feel like not for sale in the market. Keep improving yourself and be the better version of yourself. This can be done by the cultivation of micro habits. It is good to create habits like exercising, traveling to an unknown place, or even spending time alone in attaining knowledge. Taking a deep breath might help when you are feeling like your life is not going anywhere.

“You are alone is responsible for your happiness but letting in the person of people whom you trust can act as a catalyst. Never think that another person will come and solve all of your problems. Yes! It is the hard-learned fact by millions of people around us. So, it’s time for you to understand the same.”

Vishruth Harithsa

#3 Be happy if challenges are coming your way

Think about the world we are living in. It is fragile and filled with technology lines and also with poor and homelessness for many living organisms. Challenges pop in everybody’s life and because of that how many of us thrive? Almost everyone in their own way. These difficult times don’t come to us to make us weak or to lose hope. They are there to make you stronger and prepare us for the worst. Worse things happen always. Death might come or you might become a millionaire in a year and lose all your fortune in a single day because the stock fell.

Remember how you were when you started something for yourself in life. Maybe it is your first venture, first love, first job, first-team, or your first leadership role in a big company. It is always a special moment, right? Now, remember you got promoted for the 10th time? How does it look or feel for you? Like, Just another day, didn’t you? This happens because of one of the 2 reasons, One — You stopped celebrating your success as it is like a home to you, or Two — You lost that zeal to celebrate it due to some intense situations that already made you weak.

Make sure to celebrate everything in life, whether is sadness or happiness. Either way, parties should not stop; celebrating life mustn’t stop. Challenges keep coming and sad moments keep passing in your sky like a cloud that never falls. It’s YOU who is the sole reason to live on this planet. Not for money, not for pride, not for justice, not for revenge, and not for compromises; live only for YOURSELF and to understand what’s happening inside you. After all, you are a piece of the universe.

#4 If you are in love, don’t get attached to the person get attached to the relationship

Be like a lotus, even though it lives on the water, its leaf never catches water. Be in love and love the people around you. Fall in love and enjoy life while it lasts but don’t get attached in a way that affects your happiness in life. Starting a relationship with a person is easy once you feel closer to him/her. Maintaining the same tempo and intensity is very difficult. Never show your weakness or your inside thoughts to them. Only you should be responsible for making you happy. Don’t say without you my life is over, instead tell them that with you my life will be beautiful.

You should live without that person. That person was not there with you from your birth, no matter how much you love the other person there is always a dark side when it comes to hurting their egos. When that starts affecting, crack develops in that relationship. It is like the patching of wheels. It simply gets old and becomes due for replacement.

Get attached to the relationship. I mean love. Love to love or to fall in love. If the person changes himself/herself over time, move on and find another (unless you are not married). Search for the person in your life who understands you and makes you feel yourself when you are with them. Keep very low expectations infarct zero expectation. Don’t cry when you get hurt or hurt the other person. It is all common in any relationship including friendship too. It is all part of cementing process. The more you fight, the better you understand the downsides and strong sides of your relationship with the person.

The day you start expecting, the day your fall starts in the mind of the person you love or vice versa. Hence, keep your head straight all the time and enjoy life as it is. Altering life or forcing others to live for you is all temporary.

Vishruth Harithsa

Conclusion:

So, these points that are mentioned above are from my experience & research I did from others’ life and my life. It will work for all of us when we put ourselves first and seek to understand rather than be understood. Change starts from you. Bury your past and move on with your present. I read in tweets that once you get feelings on a person it will never go in life no matter how you hate them, that feeling of care will always be there so don’t resist care but to resist to get attached. Find those happy moments in life and inspire yourself to live with them. Nothing can stop you or no challenge can bring you down. Remember to take help or ask questions when it is required. You are not a sheep to follow bling orders. Turn your shit in and stop caring for the things that bring you down. Go farther, grow bigger and live stronger. Life is full of questions and to find answers always try to look in you first and then start looking for answers in the world or other people. 99% of the time I am sure you will find answers inside you.

Keep Reading and Inspire others as well if you feel this article is worthy of sharing with someone close to you.

title: Inner DNA of Teams That Win Greatness & Teams That Pursue Revenue Target Model
description: Team of Money and the Team of Growth
imageAlt: Two diverging team paths: one circles a stack of coins, the other links small human figures into a growing branching structure; revenue targets versus meaningful growth.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
In this article, I will talk about 2 types of teams that manage to help organizations go in the right direction. We often complain about people who look at the given task from a revenue perspective like how much this is going to make us rich or our team rich. It is not actually a bad thing. We are getting our salaries at the end of each month without any hassles because of these people. I agree there are many politics and policies involved, but this is still how it is. Every stable, valuable & agile team in an organization is the result of 100s of politics, strained, gauged, quarreled, abandoned, and inflexible endeavors by each person in it.

Here I want to write about 5 points that make those teams better and coordinated to establish themselves the creative DNA in their work style and structure. I am a software engineer who is working as a consultant on behalf of Dynatrace for some of the largest organizations in India (Sometimes APAC). Having 2 major teams in an organization is important. One, that handles money and cashflow. Two maintain the rest of the processes. It is easy to have people populated with the tasks that are way out of their domain. Sometimes a mechanical engineer works as a developer. It is always important to have the right people at the right place to ensure your organization or team is structured well.

1. Assign right people to right place

It is important to have the right people at the right place in both teams who are handling money (Sales) and the growth of the company (Services). Without 2 of those teams, it will be difficult to achieve the company’s mission statement and reach near to its vision. As I observed in my experience about teams, they often tend to take credits for others’ work instead of taking credits for what exactly they did. “People blame on each other when the problem comes but when there is a credit overdue, the same people fall in line to take them.” Being professionals, we all have to keep in mind that if we are not ready to take accountability for the mistakes we did, then there is no reason for us to go forward and take credit for the work others do. Having the right people who can take accountability on behalf of their team are the ones who are a great fit to lead any team, whether it is a service or sales team. Knowing the domain comes second in this ever-accelerating technology world.

These days the hard truth is, 7-year old can become a CEO and develop an application. What sets us apart is how well we motivate our team to work up to their true potential. Inspiring people to work for you is important because not all will follow our mission statement in life. For example, my mission statement is different from others but that doesn’t mean I am right and they are wrong. I like to align my thoughts with the vision of the organization that I work for and some only want to get the job done no matter what. These are just their own perspective of life and how they live. As long as they are satisfied with what they are doing for themselves, everything is the right choice.

If you are a team lead or a manager, being creative is the most important trait. Whether the company you work for might follow a fully professional model, treat your employee as a resource model; this mindset will short live. At some point, you must switch your way of working or else your job. Having an open mindset to see opportunities around you is a special skill so develop it and by this people around you will feel good about you and the job they are doing.

If you are authoritarian, assign people to the right jobs. A person with a less creative mind or too technical a mindset is not fit for leading teams. Either that person should learn to adapt or he should be assigned to his rightful place. You cannot train fish to climb a tree no matter what it is impossible. Learning new tools that matched your working style helps you to stay productive and organized — This is not possible unless you have the right people at the right place.

2. Right decisions at the right time

When you put people who work well at the right place, obviously the standard of the company will increase. When they are in the right place, it is also necessary to make the right decision at the right place. For example, if your team is in crisis and need to fire some of your team members when you are the decision-maker, you need to carefully understand the budget of the team you have allowed for and then need to discuss with your services team lead about the problem and make him understand to come up with ideas that can save jobs as well as increase the growth rate of the team and the company. Always better service can get The company to higher places so it is important to provide the best possible service to your end-user or your business partners.

About firing people, as long as a leader hesitates to take hard decisions, the team cannot get creative or it’s difficult to build the ‘A’ team. Give one or 2 changes to grow or to show their talent to employees is a good idea but if they keep taking many chances and still no progress, it is good to tell them to part ways with the company and find another domain where they actually can put their heart and mind to. It will help them to find their path too. I had a friend where I referred her to our company and my manager gave her a lot of chances for almost a year but the improvement from her side was ordinary. She was into art and this is a technology company so she doesn’t fit in and got fired last year but ever since she got fired, her life turns out well and she now has some amazing sketches of her own.

Sometimes, there will be clashes between sales and service teams which often affect the people at the bottom of the triangle too. It affects the morale of team members where there is a cold war going on inside the company itself like civil war. Being an integral part of the company’s growth, if both teams start quarreling to credits, the overall growth of the organization affects. This sometimes might occur because of a change in leadership. When a person changes to the director’s position, this friction happens. The frequency of the new guy doesn’t match with all others below.

When this situation comes, it is good to have a meeting where all services and sales team sit together and decide the future and discuss their expectations with the new person by revisiting why they are working for the company in the first place; whether their love toward the company, for every month’s salary, for career-related or to make a difference and make a mark upon it.

“Remember to consider all your options before making decisions that affect all your team members and morale mustn’t affect at any cost.”

3. Value opinion of each team member

If you are a .manager or a team lead, you will be having people who work for you and for the company. In your team, there will be people who love the company they are working for. I am not saying 100% of your team members are loving what they work on. They also need to make a living from their work hence that love of work would be long gone in them due to the responsibilities they have in their personal life.

When you value individual opinions and consider their ideas, they start to trust you. When that trust builds between them and you, they feel at home while working. People who consider their workplace as their second home, don’t need to be monitored. They will be self-driven and become risk-takers too. Working for money will be converted to working for the mission of the company. Nothing else a company wants when each and every member start working for the company instead of for the salary they are providing. Productivity will be doubled at least.

There is an instance I like to share that happened in our team, our team started with 1 person and now within 4 years, we have grown up to 40 members. We are a services team and always growing from the feedbacks from customers and great people in our team. Now, for the first time, we engaged in 24x7 maintenance with some of the major banks in the country. The team has now got split into micro teams, program managers, and under them, there are TLs and people who are doing shifts. It is going on fine but program managers started to treat members below them as resources instead of humans. When they did that, individual opinions have no value and their many frictions started inside the team and they start to work for money.

I started working here when there were only 6 to 7 members in the team and from that day main unique point of our team was the culture and respect we had towards people. Now, many misunderstandings are started between team members and the way they work as well — I strongly feel this is because of lack of creativity in the work and offline communication. Still, the tools we are using are outdated, and also communication patterns are old. To overcome this, our services manager started open mic sessions with individuals. This might solve the problem temporarily but in a long run, innovation needs to be added to produce some phenomenal results. The above problem is facing by many companies around the world. A better solution is to streamline the thoughts of team members, not their work. Streamlining needs to be done at the root. When we start valuing every member’s suggestion, we can combine different solutions to reach a level of improvement where everyone is happy to work.

4. Free electron

This point is unconventional to follow but it works and I saw teams who did this are going wonderfully. The free electron is the process of letting a person or people (depending on the size of a team typically 50:5) roam around freely across projects and teams to look at the things that need to be taken care of. I know this because I am the free electron in our team right now. Where we give complete freedom to the electron team (the term I call for the team that works freely without boundaries) start building creative ideas around the team. They act like a boundary around. There can be 2 types of teams, Internal electron teams, and external electron teams.

The internal electron team is meant to control the affairs of the team. If it is a services team, the team should contain at least 5 members. Each of them has a unique skill.

  • Technologist (Who can learn any given skill in a short period of time),
  • Developer (Who can build or automate the workflows to accommodate difficult tasks in the team),
  • Leader (Who supports every individual and hold keys to make teamwork),
  • Creative Head (Who can inspire every team member with art, technology, and life) and
  • An All-rounder (Who knows in and out of services and technology).

The external electron team mostly handles bridges and gaps between teams. Maintains all the affairs of teams and motivates them to work with each other well. The main responsibility of this team is to remind every team in the company about the mission statement and vision of the company so that it will be aligned with every employee who works for the company. This role can also be played by the VP or director of the region.

When there is a crisis in the company this team or the person (Who I call a free electron) can pop in and try to minimize the risk of employee dissatisfaction toward the company or any team. It is not mandatory to hire people, especially for the electron team. You can assign this to the people who already know about your team and willing to go extra mile for the betterment of your team or the company.

5. People to adapt and learn quickly

These days, inventions in technology are getting doubled every 18 months. The skill you know now will get outdated in the next 5 years or maybe even next year. To keep up with the pace we need to learn as fast as we can and also with correct concepts and topics that match your customer or end-users.

The trigger point for each team toward progress is its people. When they collectively work together for the same purpose, difficult challenges will get easier. Multiple brains are always better than one single brain that is because viewpoints will be different. You might be looking at money or revenue but another team member might look at the quality delivery point of you, some others may look at MTTR (Mean Time To Resolution). When you are up to date with what’s going on in your industry and the tools, you can brainstorm with your team member, to adapt that tool to make life easier. Literally, more tech-savvy's in your team; better you can face challenges and get help quickly.

If your team still uses an excel sheet for tracking issues, finding issues at the right time and management of that issue will become clumsy. If a team member comes in with an idea to use Incident Management System and train others to use the same, Hola!!! You can quickly store, organize, search and keep track of every activity or issues that are reported to your peers or your customer about their application. What will happen to productivity now? I will leave this question for you to answer.

Conclusion:

Managing a team is a tough task and imagine the whole company of 2000 people. This article is based on my experience and observation of teams that work across my reach. I found many politics that happen internally with customers as well as members in your team with other teams. At last, everything comes to the ego of the person who is there in that place and gets a chance to prove that guy is right on his decisions. Few are really good at making decisions and managing a company or team. Finally, each professional will act based on his instincts rather than thinking about what’s right for the team. I am not telling everyone does that but most of us do. People who understand the big picture are the ones who can lead well and also the people who align their vision toward the company they work for are rare to be found. If you have that person in your team, never let that person get away because they are crazy ones. As Steve Jobs says and it is already proven,

Crazy ones are the ones who have the potential to change the world and make it better for living.

Keep reading for more articles and wish you have a happy days ahead. Please check out my website for more updates and collections of my work, thetechnologist.in

title: Procrastination of Deep Thoughts
description: Part 1: Negative Side of Thinking About Not Knowing Anything (Questions that I asked myself in my journey of reinvention)
imageAlt: A looping ink knot above an open notebook slowly unwinds into one clear question-shaped path toward a horizon; deep thoughts and uncertainty.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Lately, I have been in this deep thought process that affected my life extremely. With this overwhelming availability of knowledge all around us and people seems to be always better than me. Readers, Writers, Artists, Programmers, Professionals, Family, and the Rest of some amazing people. In this quest of gaining knowledge, I fell behind with updates about how to go ahead. I am guiding my friends and family members to move forward in life with clear guidance but what I feel inside is a lack of something that guides me in my journey. I am a guide to many but who guides me in my journey? Do I need to follow my intuition? Do I need to consider myself as a beacon of light and guide myself? I read books and I never think twice if I get a chance to buy one. Now, my books collection-number have reached up to 200 and out of the 35 is completed by the time I am writing this article.

Who am I exactly? What I am gonna do in my life? The Art of Clear Thinking says, “Have intellectual honesty, Be open-minded, Not to trust my instincts, & Think like greats or Greats think alike.” Every time I leave myself watching a Netflix series, I feel terrible about me wasting precious time where I can use that to learn a lot of things with unlimited access to the Internet. To add to my frustration, I have got unlimited access to Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform to learn anything I can as a part of R&D from our company Dynatrace. Getting access to Azure was my prime dream when I first heard of it in 2012. I was thinking that Azure replaces Desktop computers in the future and it will give everyone the ability to use high-end computers with just a monitor and Internet connection. This has proven to be damn true years later. Finally, after 8 years, I got access to it and I have unlimited seamless access to it. What else a techie need, right?

It is very hard to choose what to do when we are presented with several opportunities to learn at the same time. All of us just got 24 hours and to function properly, our body needs at least 6 hours of sleep so we all left with 18 hours in a day. Let’s consider this analogy suits only me so What should I do with 18 hours of my day left? I gotta eat and survive so I need to work 8 hours round the clock to get my salary — This is not true in my case as everything I work is about learning and my team is so supportive of me in doing innovation so we are a family and it doesn’t feel that I am working for someone — I love what I am doing and work that I am in, is a perfect fit for my mind and career. I am a Performance Engineer/Software Engineer ( APM). I loved technology from day 1 where the Nokia 1100 handset was released and we used to stand in a big queue to get BSNL SIM cards for ₹ 999/- Of course I wanted to be an Astronaut by then and later I have found out that If you have eyesight (Myopia) you can’t get into Aeronautics career of flying planes or travel through space. Hence I chose to be a Technologist (It is a long story I will tell you in my next articles). Even now I adore Astrophysics and I have a plan to complete my Ph.D. within 10 years — A pretty ambitious goal for a guy who doesn’t even have graduation till now.

Deep Thoughts

Know Nothing

In my mind, there is this deep thought where I believe that I know nothing more often. Regularly I am asserting myself with this statement, “I know nothing.” I read that our subconscious accepts what our Objective mind thinks more often. So, instead of thinking that I should not be arrogant for whatever the things I know, I keep telling myself that there are a lot of things are there to learn so I know nothing about them. So, this level of thinking is keeping me from thinking I am a genius but this is still having a downside and making me feel sad sometimes or it even causes burnout.

After some research on how to get out of this dogma, I started to read more and analyze the root cause of this problem. When you keep telling your mind that you don’t know something instead of telling that you know this but not deep enough, your brain actually processes the information you send as trash and neglects it. It will just store in short-term memory and let it go once you shutdown yourself every night. Whatever the words you learn or the concepts you understand it will only store in short term. To tackle, please try and keep talking to yourself, “I know many things but still there is to learn more. Let me enjoy learning and be curious about new things in life. Whatever comes I will accept it as a knowledge.”

This approach changed my thinking and it made me learn more comfortably and with freedom. It matters in life what you speak to yourself and be careful while doing that because you are what you think inside you not what others say about you.

Thought Multiplication

When we are lost in thinking about something, for example, the position we are in now because of our past, it is difficult to come out of that box and stay happy for what we have right in front of us. Lost causes and lost times can never be mended. Dwelling on past memories is like finding a lion in a group of foxes — You never find one.

When we observe ourselves standing in this kind of life, the best thing to do is to come out of it, but how? Is it easy to come out of a whirlpool dragging you to the bottom? You gotta double your speed to swim away from it. There are sometimes when deep thoughts multiply themselves and start dragging you deeper into your painting stretch in mind like a black hole. A funny thing about a black hole is, nothing can escape it. No matter how fast you are or how hard you try to get out of it, it will become impossible and you start to revolve around it as an event horizon (Black Hole Rings).

Do we have any idea how to escape from this? Giving in to it is the only way for us? I don’t think so. There is an option that is still untested by me but thousands say it is possible. “Be patient, wait for your chance. Until then, do nothing.” Nothing can hold you forever when you are persistent in getting out. Even you can’t stop yourself from achieving your goal when you are persistent.

Productivity Obsession

While reading books we often come across these words about not wasting time and making use of every 10 min cycle of life. Creating an environment around you that always pushes you to go next level in life. How can we possibly be continuous in its process? How can we even be productive 24 hours of every single day? At some point, we gotta look at life and its attraction. At some time, we got to see the worst of life. At some point, we might even have to be lazy because of the lack of energy or exhaustion. It is okay to be unproductive sometimes in life. Productivity gets its value only when your unproductive times say that you can do better.

Don’t stop yourself from being lazy or wasting your time. Make a path to know what’s good for you in life. Be better at what you are right now instead of starting something over which you know nothing about. Talk to friends, have fun with life by going out. Take your family out, ask someone to go on for a date with you, and express yourself how much love you have got in you. After all, life is a life you get to live only once. Just have fun and remember to always back people who you care for and who care for you.

No one will come and live your life for you, you gotta live it. The way you are supposed to live your life is simple. To call it in one word, Happiness. You can make you happy. Well, it is not only you that can but the first person that is supposed to make you happy should be YOU. Period. Productive or not, don’t get obsessed with either. Just live your life for happiness.

Money or No Money

It is incredible when we all think about life and how we came into existence. There was no money, no corruption, and no troubles in surviving life. These days people who have less money or can’t manage their finance call themselves having survival problems. Why? Without money can’t we survive in this world? We have created this bad habit of prioritizing money to buy ourselves luxuries. Even to drink water we need to pay money these days. Look what have we become in life.

From being explorers since the origin, we have come so far that everything is valued with currency in life. Have you ever tried to live your life with nothing (Zero Money) throughout your life? All should give it a try once for at least a month to see how far we can go.

Money is everything these days I agree but what if we stop treating it as one and treat people, happiness & love, honesty, and integrity as true currencies? Just imagine if we live that way, is there be any death of us? What if everything is free on this planet and to attain what you want all you need to do is to work something like in order for you to get an iPhone, you need to develop an app for it or if you want to eat a Pizza, all you have to do is to be a waiter and serve the same to 10 other people who attain the level of eating Pizza. It can be like a game where we travel through levels one after the other to get our powers unlocked.

This is a totally fantasy but why can’t this be possible? Because we humans like to rule? The basic self-centered instincts of a human are to dominate others or to get dominated by someone. Follow rules or make them.

To keep order we need to follow something like money but this itself not the source for our survival. I feel pity for those people who still think they are the bosses of other people. I just call them some ignorant idiots.

Spirituality

As Swami Vivekananda says,

“In the world we see that those who possess even a little secular knowledge begin to control ordinary men and oppress them out of fear. Illumined souls are different. They are fearless because they have experienced divine Consciousness and realised their oneness with God. Self-knowledge or divine Consciousness alone makes a man fearless.”

What exactly spirituality means? How it is attached to religion? Before that, what is a religion? Shitheads like us cannot understand what it truly means unless we see the world how it is instead of seeing it as an inside projection of ourselves. Religion is just a value of a human that lies underneath everything he does — I didn’t say this, great people said it after long-held research. Still, whoever said it makes sense. There is no Christian, Hindu, Muslim, Jew, Buddhist, or any others. We humans are not separated by them. We are what we are, and we are unified by the thoughts of it. Religion is just a practice you follow to keep your community in check and to follow rules. We, humans, like to see multi-color movies instead of black and white. Similarly, different religions take different approaches to explain humanity to humans. Yeah, that’s us!!! Humans! Nothing else.

Spirituality comes from religion and its strength. Acquiring great knowledge to see what’s good or bad is one easy perk of tending to be spiritual. The concept of spirituality comes from enlightenment. Enlightenment comes from knowledge — knowledge of your inner self. Nothing is different in this world as it is inside you. Realization of this fact is very important in spirituality. It means to be free from the dogmas, assertions, thoughts, and all other materialistic holds you have in this world. Spirituality is not only meant for those who sit in caves or live their lives in forests. It is there for everyone to take it. High-level beings just forbid us and made our minds weak to even think about it. Be strong and fearless, you will be enlightened automatically and you are already are a spiritual being.

These thoughts are the ones that I learned by observing and reading books and discussions with my Mom. With all these aspects of spirituality, one thing according to me stands out is the mystery embedded in this. Why everyone can’t attain knowledge that leads to the enlightenment of our soul. Is soul really a thing? Does it exist or it is just the projection of our mind that seeks higher knowledge? Many questions arise if we think about it. Answers are many. Most of them are diluted with the opinions of the teller. Each of us has different opinions about what it is and why it is like that. I am not writing this to find answers, I am just questioning about what is there. Is this actually a reality or temporal distortion plane? Are we real or this is just an illusion? What do we think of as an illusion is an actual reality? No idea.

It is not necessary to go that far and find answers. We all have got one life and what happens to us after our death or what is happening behind us or in the universe doesn’t matter. We are here breathing Oxygen, finding our way to be free, and enjoy luxuries that this world is about to offer. So, it is good to live in present rather than thinking about what happened or what’s gonna happen. Live in present as much as you can; if the answers to those questions are meant to be found, it will come to the light by itself. Be strong, fearless, and adaptable.

Gender Domination

Before moving on to discuss human relationships, I want to use some space to write about women/girls and life of them. I am from a middle-class Indian family and I look every day outside and see a hole or dent in the culture that I am surrounded by. Irrespective of culture every human being is the same with having the same emotions but they experience and digest in different ways. Every mind is a treasure of knowledge and an exceptional energy converting factory. My point here is about women and their lives. I hardly see girls rise up to the occasion. Girls born as the most beautiful creatures in the world and the most attractive too. To start their life with, they are everyone’s baby girl and elders treat them like a treasure of beauty. As they grow old and ascend to youth, it changes.

I have my friends who still struggling in the web of lies, dogma, confusions, and confessions. One thing common I observed in them — in every one of them is, lack of focus toward life and they have no idea what to do. They just say I want freedom from all this and they should get out of this social pressure altogether. The simple fact is, unless you don’t know what exactly to do in life, you can’t decide what you don’t want or you want. It is just a whirlpool of dilemmas in life. It is not so easy to come out of it until this comes from their mind, “SCREW YOU, I am going to do this in my life and nobody will be able to stop me.” Society will keep imposing a number of unhealthy things on girls and even on boys sometimes especially when they are between the age between 25 and 30 — This is not going to be changed any sooner. Even our next generation children/youth will be facing the same problem as long as we change ourselves inside us. Children will part ways with their parents as they grow old and reach their youth that is primarily because of the marital pressure that a girl should get married within 25 and that kind of bullshits.

This will be continued in my next part of this article. As a conclusion to this part, I would like to say about the life that we are all living in. One question for you, think about all the things that are happening in life and the origin of your physical existence. We are all made of stardust, elements, compounds, and matter which are bound together by a form of energy. The biology of any living body is almost the same as the chemistry of non-living things. For a moment, if you project yourself out of your physical body, what do you see? Everything is the same, right? Living things or non-living things. Each and everything has its own memory and life injected in it in the form of different energies. Now, simply give it a thought that how can you say exactly we are living? We may be non-living for non-living things (what we call them) and for non-living, they are the real living things. This is the paradox of life and oneness in all is the main principle of Advaita.

Until next time. Keep reading and Be happy. Wish you all a good time.

title: Wire-Free World For One Year
description: Digital Minimalism is good but to what extent? Wire-Free is not wireless. It is all about being disconnected with updates.
imageAlt: An unplugged cable rests in an open circle beside an open window with a blue horizon; choosing a year away from digital updates.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
We know we are running in this life requesting to thrive with money, fame, freedom, and exposure. There are a few of us who command life and steer away from top concerns like it is nothing. Always looking after yourself and family is a good thing. Thinking of being selfish in such a way that only your inner circle are the ones who are living in this world, is totally absurd. The point I am trying to make in my article here is, we are humans and what is happening in the last 20 years is that technology is ripping every part of humans in our life.

In the last decade, we started to use smartphones considerably more as they were introduced at the end of the last decade. This adoption of extra device in life made us stay ourselves away from ourselves. This has become the prime solution for anyone’s loneliness. What we are not understanding is that this is making all of the sick. Pushing away from people instead of connecting with them more. A user who uses social media thinks that he/she is connecting with the world but actual fact that is happening is, he/she might be getting connected with people around the world but what about the people around him?

Social media are literally pushing you away from people who are with you, near you, and pulling people who can be the reason to lose your mind. I am not telling using smartphones and social media is bad. What I am trying to imply here is that there should be a limit to what we do with or how we use technology that is constantly developing exponentially. The true nature of human is not being used correctly. We are not machines to constantly go on with the life-like we are already controlled by the people who are sitting at the top level.

Let’s analyze these 2 sceneries together: (These I have considered in their utmost levels)

  1. Staying away from technology makes our life disconnected from the world.
  2. Being in technology makes us disconnect from our natural human life.

#1 Staying away from technology makes our life disconnected from the world

Well, remember when we use to play games with our friends and families? There was a celebration in every holiday season. Our whole family uses to come together and the fun part was the house that was filled with happiness. Great cooking, Grandfather’s stories about how he used to flirt with our granny in their 20s, Stories that were filled with lots of morals, inspirations. All of these were there without a single device near to us. It is like we lived in the countryside with that work disconnection with no disruptions from our debt owners.

This was the life of kids who were born before 1995. We were indulging in celebrations without much stress. Every task was divided into our elders and they use to take care of that and also they would teach them about their experiences.

The above words of remembrance are one good thing about staying away from technology. We were happy and well educated but up to what extent? Ask this question if you are born before 1995.

“I wish I’d have gotten the chance like my son, my brother, or like my younger peers who are brilliantly smart where they started learning to program or they started to take classes online when they were just 3 years or 10 years.” Haven’t we thought about this? We did.

#2 Being in technology makes us disconnect from our natural human life

As per the research from the RescueTime app team, one of the iOS and Android applications. An average user uses a little over 3 hours 15 mins every day of screen time and the top 20% uses shockingly around 4 and a half hours per day. This stat might be an interesting fact since the advent of technology in our lives. If you imagine a software engineer, accountant, or any employee, they use more than 12 to 13 hours of their day using technology like smartphones, desktops, laptops, online meetings. Especially in this COVID times, I am sure all of us use at least 10 hours of our day in screen time that is more than 1/3 rd of our time.

Using technology is often making us be indulged more in online activities than offline activities. This is making things difficult for the people around you, think of your parents, children, partner. Oh, wait!! These days even they will get their own devices. If you want to talk to the person in the next room, take out your phone and text them via WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, or iMessage and they will reply to you back. This is how it has become. Instead of walking slowly toward them and speaking with them with a smile on your face, you are texting them with emojis. This is what technology brings us. But, think of this, what if there is no technology or Internet to connect us all together.

Do you think people who are working from now would be having their jobs in this pandemic? Would companies have survived? So, technology may push humans away but it also helped us to survive in these difficult times. Without that, we all would have been out of sorts in life without directions.

Comparisons

This topic is very much debatable and the debate is going on all around the world about The Advent of Technology On Humanity.

Don’t you think we have had enough of technology advancements to go on for at least the next 1 year without any improvements? Can’t we make it the existing tools and products more stable? What if we pause our progress for next year? We maybe not enough advanced in exploring space technology and building telescopes that can predict alien lives or elements on the surface of the planet. We might not there yet but how the world is going now is messing things up. If we compare the difference between 1960 to 2017, there has been a huge increase in the number of phone users and fixed-line users. If we consider the last 7–8 years of data on increase in wireless technology, we will get shocked. The below charts will explain it to us.

The introduction of technology in the lives of people has increased as per the research in certain age groups, this is according to the “Life Satisfaction in the Internet Age — Changes in the Past Decade,” published in Computers in Human Behavior, 2016. According to this paper, Using the internet makes people happier, especially seniors and those with health problems that limit their ability to fully take part in social life, says the study paper. To make this more interesting, this also says that Internet access among seniors rose from 8 to 34 percent between 2003 and 2012; among the younger group, access increased from 44 to 78 percent. Therefore, the digital divide grew during the study period.

If you are smart enough, you will understand how technology is impacting our life. My point here is not about minimizing technology it is about how useful it is to certain age groups and for a young age it is not so important. My above hypothesis is all about putting a break for 1 year in any technological advancement and shifting the concentration toward human development. If we can just connect with important things and let the updates go in this duration, this will help our humanity in numerous ways. For example, consider all smartphone manufacturers to stop releasing their new flagship products for 1 year. Even computer manufacturers or application teams all around the world and survive with what exactly we really have at this moment. This will not only improve the lives of people, it will also help protect our environment if these companies invest in the growth of the environment. I am not telling that they should stop their manufacturing these gadgets, I am telling instead of investing in improving technology or adding new features to the products, they can just go ahead with the existing one and see it in the markets.

Think, if there is an innovation pause. Children will connect with their parents instead of going through their phones with all extra updates. A small change can make a huge difference in well being. The people who are chasing around flagship devices will stop their pursuit and get the satisfaction of settling for the device that is a flagship for the next 2 years.

It is not so easy to adopt but if all companies come together and say, let’s contribute to humanity instead of fighting to be on top, our world can be a much much better place. This is not so difficult, isn’t it? If we stop add new features or inventions for a year, Earth will not stop rotating or even Universe will not come and ask us why did we stop.
