The first principle to build a purposeful life. Without getting to know the meaning of persistence, it is difficult to go on with life. There is a small difference in being persistent and in being consistent. Persistency is pursuing something you like to complete and wish to see its end goal as your mission. Consistency is built with something even more advanced than persisting something. There is no limit to set an end goal for it. Sometimes, consistency even doesn’t have an end goal. It just goes on and on until you are alive. It is principle-centered.

For example, if you are on to something or someone, you cannot give up till an end goal is achieved. A son continuously requests his parents to get him a video game until they buy him one. This is persistence. Consistency is putting efforts every day to learn how to play a game and getting to the top of the leaderboard in that game.

In our life, consistency helps us to reach the goals that we set and also helps us to go on even after achieving our goal to keep it in check and never to lose our track. If you have decided to read 10 books in the next 90 days, being consistent every day in reading books will take you to the end of the goal. Once you read all the 10 books, the consistent mind of yours demands you not to break the sequence by helping you convert this goal as a habit.

To achieve your goal, you need a plan. An important point in your plan should contain a goal to build better habits. To build better habits, you require consistency — Being consistent helps you to build better habits and better habits will help you to reach your goal with discipline.

Once we achieve consistency, life will open doors to the next level to explore focus without distraction. That is focussing toward the goal.

2. Focus:

The principle of focus is direct and every individual has their statement and way of focussing on the required goal. It is not likely to have a laser focus without zero distractions. Focussing on something requires determination and dedication.

  • Determination: If you are determined to do something, you require consistency to achieve that goal. You cannot reach your endpoint by working super hard today and not working tomorrow. Working hard means putting certain amounts of effort every day without fail and get ahead with the collective improvement you gained by those consistent efforts. Find your goal/endpoint to reach even it is small doesn’t matter. All you have to do is to complete it. Determination to complete what you have started is the dedication.
  • Dedication: 2nd step of focus is the dedication to reach the endpoint. How we get there is not the talking point here. What we do to get there is important and how better we perform in that aspect of life. Dedication with focus helps you get there without any distractions.

Determination and Dedication are the parts of focus that open a doorway to achieve it less disturbingly. As long as we have 2Ds (Determination & Dedication), focussing toward goal or endpoint will become nearly a straight line.

Focus toward a goal is the first step we take after being consistent with our life and build habits to improve ourselves. I can say, sharpening the saw. We all can understand the importance of not stopping or being consistent with the things that we do. Let’s understand how patience is the key to focus better in life to reach our goal.

3. Patience:

Now is the time to unlock the power of patience. The power comes from the pause we take when we make decisions. The 5-second gap between response and stimulus takes you to a different level in your life. We all need quick fixes in life such as quick solutions to the problems, quick satisfaction to the work, quick results for the effort you put in, quick money making methods and much more quick responses in the things we do. It is embedded in our DNA. In this type of culture that is fast-growing, being patient comes with many perks. Taking a moment before reacting to anything that includes while eating something or before starting your engine every day.

To understand how patience works in our life, I spent straight 15 days without reacting to any frustrating situation. I kept reminding myself about being patient without reacting to it. As Dr. Covey explained in his masterpiece “The 7 Habits of Highly Successful People”, being proactive has a great effect on our self-improvement life. Pausing before reacting or understanding ourselves before seeking to be understood by others builds patience in us. We all are bound to destiny and there is no way we can react without thinking of the present situation or understanding ourselves.

When we learn to be calm, patience takes its place in our journey. It is the projection of our values and the principle we develop in our life while we move to different stages of life.

For instance, you cannot build a million-dollar business within a day or you cannot go and marry your crush within 24 hours. Building a business or getting your girlfriend to marry you at an instant is the most unlikely scenario. You gotta be patient and win her trust and in business, you need to understand how it works in the real world. You need a plan, knowledge about money and many other things. So, understanding and trusting something or someone takes time and for that, you have to be patient.

Consistency helps to develop good habits if we are consistent in working on them furthermore, patience helps us to reach our goal and plan every step ahead of us. Focus is a joint between consistency and patience. It connects all 3 principles to associate with the most effective principle decision-making.

4. Decision-Making:

The most effective and rapid results-oriented principle. You know when to put brakes to your car when you find a dog running on the road. There are no good or bad decisions. The only thing you need to worry about the decision you take concerning time. Worst decisions at the right time might become good ones in the future but a good decision at a bad time, cannot get you back what you have lost at the time when you have given choice to make the decision.

Here good and bad decisions are related to you and only you. There is no short cut, no mercy to gain what you have lost due to a lack of courage in making decisions. In your journey of achieving your goal, you might make bad decisions that pull you back a bit or slow you down in reaching your destination. Nobody is perfect and not all decisions have to be right all the time. There will be the right time where you can make up for anything bad you did in your past. You just need to have the courage to identify the right time to act.

In making a better decision, courage plays an important role. You cannot hesitate to make decisions either they are bad or good when the right time comes. I always tell my friends that the right decisions at the right time is the key to a happy life or to reach goals.

If you feel the time is right and your inability to act in that time or take decisions will pull you far more away from your goal. Do something at the time whether a bad decision of a good one. If the decision is bad, you learn from it and it becomes a good experience for you in the future. If it is a good decision, your life will automatically help you move forward in your journey. Either way, you don’t stop moving toward your goal.

  • No decision scenario: This is not acceptable. When you don’t take action, there will be no consequences. Where there are no consequences, there is no progress. In this way, your journey stops at wherever you are.
  • Pseudo decision scenario: This is more unacceptable than the above scenario. At least no decision stops you in making progress but this will pull you back from the progress and asks you to go another path from your original goal-oriented path. It changes your life completely. When you come across the situation to act or make a decision, do something if you stay in a dilemma and start thing that you can handle both good and bad decisions at the same time will completely take you out of the picture in your journey.

Don’t hesitate when the opportunity is passed onto you to act on something (decision-making), be courageous and be visionary. Good decisions take you toward your goals whereas bad ones teach you or show you the path to it. But never commit to act on both, it will just take you out of the whole game and the bigger picture.

Special Principle

After all independence we have in our journey, it is the time to go through the powerful principle that we all need to follow on to lead the social life i.e. balance.

Learning to balance the mentioned principles is what we need to do. Interdependency is the key to unlock the life that contains the door that is waiting to be open. You can travel to your goal all alone but when you look back at your journey, what you remember matters.

Balance:

Balancing between you and the people around you like family, colleagues, friends, spouse, strangers takes a big heart and an open mind. Letting people in your life is a good thing. It is difficult to trust anyone but trusting is not the issue here as long as you are on the streak of unconditional toward you. Better balance comes when you start giving yourself respect — An immense respect.

Change and Adoption are tools to balance life. Life change, you adapt to it — This cycle goes on forever. The person who fails to adapt to the changes fails to balance. When you have a poor balance in life, nothing/nobody will be left with you at the end of your journey.

Looking back at it seems like you’ve failed even you are a winner. Hence, listen to your heart and try to communicate with people as much as you can. Life is a journey that goes on forever but when you travel in it with the people who care for you gives a meaning to it. Try not to make it a solo trip. It is not meant to be like that.

The true balance comes in life when you learn to listen to others and understand them. Seek to understand than to be understood.

Seek to understand….. to be understood — Stephen R Covey

You — Profession — Family — Friends — Strangers — Goal travelled towards — Goal — Life exists.

Final Mission Statement:

It seemed clear for me after experiencing me following all the above principles in my life. I learned to be consistent in my efforts, stayed focussed about what I want to do in life and what to eliminate, waiting for my chances to explain myself that how things need to go in life; patiently explained my subconscious to look for a solution to go further and then it pointed out to my poor decision-making skills. I improved in making better decisions by consistently focussing on my goal patiently. At last, balancing all 4 of those principles unlocked the doors to the purpose of my life to go on.

I just found out the whole mission statement of my life that

Building myself to be strong and to help build others their strength to stand up and fight for themselves by holding principles of being Consistent, Focussed, Patient and Decisive maintained with Balance.

Conclusion:

When I seem to go off track, I just started to write differently. I don’t want to write simply anything hence decided to work on myself by experiencing real things before writing something. All I tried with this article is to find myself a mission for life and this is like a reminder for my life that I am going to be what I visualize to become. Having a mission statement in everyone’s life is as important as eating bread every day.

Journey of thousand miles starts with a single step

— Lao Tzu

Happy reading, keep setting mission statements in your life and please let me know yours in the response. I’d love to read them. If you have a suggestion, you can find me: theharithsa@gmail.com

Always yours, Vishruth Harithsa

title: Betrayal Doesn’t Exist
description: Betrayals happen for those who are not smart enough to persuade.
imageAlt: A cracked ceramic cup repaired with one warm golden seam sits beside a small open hand; trust, disappointment and reframing betrayal.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
As we all know there are only 4 kinds of feeling in this world and the rest of other emotions that we get is the part of them. Pleasant, Unpleasant, Calm & Arousal are the 4 feelings where the rest of the emotions like jealousy, possession, vengeance, blessing, happiness, love, etc. comes under them.

Betrayal is a part of the feeling that is arousal. In our daily lives, we see many people are outsmarted by others who have experience, advantages, and influences. Becoming a part of something that represents this kind of feeling, drag our mental emotions down. It will be hard to wake up from it.

Assume that you outsmarted someone in getting a job or taking contracts from customers. For a brief period, your competitor will become jealous or envy — this is an unpleasant feeling.

Stop being sad for such feelings and start working on those, that define who you are and what you are made of. Every one of us is having a unique skill set. Nobody is better than anybody. If your friend communicates well with the people and you are being shadowed by his/her skill, the problem is not your friend. It is the problem inside you to think about your friend that he/she is better than you.

If Steve Wozniak, thought about Steve Jobs as the person who talks well with others and persuasive ability of him is better than his invention skills, we never would have got a chance to use one of the best technology marvels of our generation (iPad, macOS, iPhone, iPod -Legacy, MacBook and Mac Pro).

See now, what do you think about betrayal? Is it the problem of the people around you or the person who is inside you? Of course, it is a problem of the person who is inside you that making you feel unpleasant or arousing bad feeling about other people.

How to overcome deceit?

When we are bypassed by someone who thinks better than us, we become pale and weak by knowing how they are growing off from the growth of them.

Making sure that you are smart enough no not to get deceived, you have to understand the worth of your self-respect. The best thing to not to be deceived in life is to make part of you to be selfish in decision-making.

Recently, I have faced a similar situation. I’d rather say I was not smart enough to understand the things around me. Hence, I was outsmarted by the people around me. Here is what I did to overcome, I consulted one of my very few people who I trust and I got the advice to be selfish and bad as I can be — Bad not in the sense of illegal manner, bad means as the badass you can be.

It was hard for me to understand what was happening in my life. I was completely lost in life with emotional attachment. Thus, I chose to do what matters in life. I adopted essentialism and this doesn’t make me selfish, it just made me explore my life and later helped me to eliminate unwanted thoughts that were going on in my mind.

Execution to become better was pretty hard for me therefore, I started to list out all the things that made me feel I am weak and in another sheet of paper, I wrote my strengths. When I combined both of ’em, I was only able to list my weaknesses more than strength. This happens in everyone’s life when we feel remorse and betrayed. So, here is the challenge for you — start telling yourself every day that you are smarter than you think and whatever happened all because for a reason and good — this ritual practice will help you to get out of weakness pretty soon.

Life is not just about how we live it. It is like a school that deposits all experiences that are good and bad into our account. Our principles, character, and values define us to move on with life.

The very basic trait we all can have is to increase our spirit by feeding our minds with rightful information that makes us smarter. Improving our everyday bit by bit will change our life on the whole.

We are lazy to change our habits that can change our destiny as Stephen Covey says,

Sow a thought, reap an action; Sow an action, reap a habit; sow a habit, reap a character; sow a character, reap a destiny. — Stephen R Covey

It starts from thought and it ends in shaping up to our destiny. If you think of something good, good things will follow. If you think of bad, bad things will happen.

It is similar in betrayal as well. When we start thinking that the betrayal is happened to get a good life and to move on, nothing can stop you from achieving what you are destined to be. If you start thinking that betrayal made you a loser or took everything from you, you can never be able to reap the good destiny that is waiting for you in life.

Betrayal is faced by the people who went out and took risks, who are crazy, who are surprisingly good at doing tasks. People who play safe never face betrayals as well as they never see challenges in life. Life without challenge is like a pizza without cheese.

Go out there try something new. Don’t fear for life or people who are smarter than you. You can only be smarter than them if you know them. Read people, explore individuals, take risks to enjoy the journey of life.

Betrayal is not an end, it is the start of a new road to explore and execute your destiny by eliminating one threat at a time.

Keep reading and Keep Learning

title: How Mission and Vision Could Get You on OMG! Insider
description: An article about how to create a purpose for your life with milestones and goals. Mission and Vision have OMG! Stats later.
imageAlt: A lighthouse and an unmarked map joined by a winding route with three milestone stones; translating mission and vision into goals.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
When we set our goals, we set milestones to achieve them. milestones are those that help us to achieve our goals. When we look at the broader view in our journey of life, what exactly are goals? How it helps us to lead our life better? Achieving goals are not only the purpose of life. There will always be higher purposes to work for and that is never going to end even after our death. Achieving visions that we stand for takes more than a lifetime and there are people where their visions are achievable at least for them. It is all about what we think and differs from person to person and their broader perspectives.

In this life, there are 4 kinds of feelings and so does for our vision. Vision is the longest and ultimate purpose of life to lead our lives. What do we need to do to reach there? Visions are hard to reach but anyone can dream about ti infinite lengths. For example, I have a vision of unlocking all the secrets and mysteries of the universe. Achieving this is impossible for me alone, if 7 billion minds come together to solve the mystery of the universe, the probability of achieving it will become higher.

Visions can be self-interested or mutual between people or can be a collective effort. Just to make things simple and intuitive, I divided vision into 4 steps i.e Milestones, Goals, Mission & Vision. For everyone to reach their visions, one can follow this technique of dividing into 4. This idea was inspired by the podcast On Purpose by Jay Shetty when he was interviewing Mike Posner. In his podcast, he mentioned that goals are changing in the lives of people but mission becomes the higher purpose of achieving. For Example, I want to become a millionaire in 6 months is a goal. Considering to help people for your whole life after you become a millionaire can be a mission.

Self-interested visions are like looking at yourself when you are at the position of unstoppable. You can set your vision of becoming a philosopher and inspiring millions of people to change their lives so that world can be a better place — is a vision that can be achieved by only you and collective efforts of others is not required to achieve that — you can read, learn and gain experience and by that, you can get near to achieve your vision.

Let’s walkthrough about the 4 steps of vision that we need to understand and this helps to gain confidence in achieving our visions.

Milestones:

Milestones are those that are short-term and can help us reach our goals. Dividing goals into several milestones help us to achieve goals rather quicker than having a goal without milestones. Consider you have a goal to change your job in 6 months. To change your job within that period, you have to do some certain tasks to make sure you seem interested to other recruiters. If you break the goal into certain specific small tasks like updating your CV, making your LinkedIn profile interesting, doing some online courses to brush up your skills or even certification & contacting the right consultancies for an interview.

Following these milestones make you reach the goal you have in mind is a better way than having only one thing in mind to change the job. Break your goals into milestones and completing each milestone will help you to reach your goal quicker and better.

Goals:

Goals are impulsive. We set our goals as we move on with our lives. We think of life with goals that give us comfort and happiness. Goals are straight forward and ever-changing. It changes for you as you keep on reaching it. If your goal is to become the greatest footballer of all time, what would you do after becoming one? At that point, your goal again changes to reach a certain level or to help people or making society better. If your goal is to read 1000 books, after reading those books, your mind carves to read more and you again set another goal to read 1000 more. Goals work like this and it keeps changing one after the other.

Mission:

The mission is the long-term goal that requires us to work for it by achieving goals. Achieving milestones, take us to reach a goal but achieving several goals may lead us to completion of mission or it’s different. The setting a mission for our life means defining the purpose of it. It is one of the higher purposes of our life. It is an achievers’ goal where they want to make a difference through their presence. If you think about building a business that makes trillion dollars and employs thousands of people, that is your mission which is set to come true one day based on the work you put it to make it a reality.

Isolated from vision, we can call mission as also called a short-term vision that needs to be achieved in a single lifetime that implies solace. If our presence is making this world a better place, think that the purpose of your life is served and connection to bad obligations is severed.

Vision:

As I already mentioned about the vision, it is the greatest purpose of life which sometimes takes more than a lifetime to achieve. If we consider an organization like Google, its vision is to provide the information of the world in a click. They are achieving it but not at the full scale. Achieving the vision takes more than reaching milestones, goals, and mission. We ought to impose different kinds of variables into it. Visions can be achievable and also at the same time, we cannot figure the things out about reaching them.

Why have a vision if it is not achievable?

If we have a vision for our life or the companies that has the vision tends to move in a path where that connects the dots to meet at a certain point close to vision. The paths we choose to change over time but if the vision is constant, it doesn’t matter which path you are choosing, ultimately you will find a way back to focus on your vision even in your lost days. I can say vision as a compass no matter how old the tech might be, it always shows you the right direction. In following the direction shown by compass, we then try to discover new routes that can take us to our vision one day or the process of finding the greatest purpose helps us to find the real purpose of life.

Every soul’s purpose is to get salvation likewise, in a journey of births and deaths, we find an adventure to capitalise on and enjoy the thing called life.

OMG! Insider:

The interesting fact about mission and vision is that mission is for a lifetime and vision is something that has got a higher purpose. When we take a look at life from a broader perspective, Goals become milestones of mission and missions will be the milestones of the vision. Ultimately, as long as we keep expanding our thinking and broaden our views, larger things will become smaller ones.

A vision gives you a general direction for life while a process goal is part of the dream that you are accomplishing by taking specific actions today. — Thomas Abreu

Unless we open our mind, the journey in life will become miserable and makes us run behind money, wealth and success. Success is a variable for every life. For your success might be earning money, having a car and buy a million-dollar villa. For others, having a roof above their heads and 3 times of food every day is a success.

When we open our minds, we invite infinite possibilities to think and adapt. Meeting new people, reading books, listening to podcasts & sharing views with people who oppose your thoughts and make it perfect to make them understand are the facts that will make you interested and opens your mind to welcoming things that you never imagined they exist.

Conclusion:

Milestones, Goals, Mission & Vision are the basic setup that this universe has given to every living being. From mother protecting her kid to a tree giving shade to infinite birds, we all are connected in the world. Carrying out each of the effects that brings humanity a subtle art of living.

Think again before setting any goals in life, divide them in milestones and later convert goals into achieving your mission that is connected to all goals you have acomplished. Vision comes later which directs your mission to reach it’s destination forever.

Happy Reading and Goal Setting.

This article is also published in harithsanotes.substack.com.

title: Kindness is Ingenious
description: Kindness is the key in reinvention or redemption of our past failures and success
imageAlt: A pair of open hands pass a small paper bird through a circle of warm light; kindness and reinvention.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
We always wonder how life is and what it is made of. Recently, I learned 3 things to live for, Consistency, Patience, and Focus. Each one of them is very difficult to come by. It requires a lot of practice and determination that should be guided by devotion toward growth. I can write all day about how to be a good productive person and what it takes to be kind and humble individual but unless you follow your own rules and discovered experiences, nothing makes sense. I write so that it may help others to learn from my mistakes or any takeaways.

Everyone around here has their own rules for life and culture to lead. The only thing that stops us from going insane is kindness and patience. Conscious about being kind most of the time is hard to come by. We need to make this a habit. In this article, I am going to list and tell you what it takes to be kind of how that helped me to rediscover a few things that led me to become what I am now.

Life is cruel sometimes and this happens because of the past doings or the decisions that we took in life. When I was young, I liked people who shown much care and love to me in a kind way and the people who are scolding, are considered to be my villains. later, I understood the people who were villains are the ones who cared for me more. Kindness comes in 2 types, one is internal and another is external. I observed many people in my life where people who seem to be rude are the ones who are kind internally and polite people are the ones tougher internally.

We act rude because of the insecurity and the fear we have for this world. There is a concept where there is no need to either hard nor polite in life. Balancing between ourselves is the true path for kindness. When we stop being fearful, this opens the way for the kindness that is required in life.

How to reinvent ourselves with Kindness?

There are millions of people around the world are helping millions who need help but still, billions are there in need of help. Before helping someone, we need to help ourselves with the thoughts that inspire us. We can observe in our daily life, when we work hard or we don’t work for some time, we become rusty and it’s difficult to obliterate procrastinating mind. Our thoughts will burn out and when we don’t get to decide what to do with life.

Before doing something different, try these things to follow kindness in life,

  • Never blame anyone or any situation in life: Blaming is a powerful thing. Who or what you blame, comes nearer to you than peace. So, if you ever want to blame something, blame peace to encounter peace all the time.
  • Remember the person you love: Do you love someone or yourself doesn’t matter, just remember the person. This gives you inner strength in handling tough times and makes difficult calls.
  • Help at least a person whenever you can: When you are traveling, walking or you see a person who needs help, just go and talk to him/her and ask what she needs. Sometimes, people need someone to listen to their problems. If you at least listen to them, it is equally beneficial to them as you are donating money to them.
  • Think about ideas and write them down: Lot of ideas come to our mind, while bathing, traveling and when we are mostly alone and thinking about us. List ’em down in a book. Writing is effective than storing digitally.
  • Get busy in redirecting your thoughts to different categories: If you are feeling not doing anything, take some time out from your routine and start to focus and calm your mind. Once your mind is calm, start thinking about different things like, how do rats sleep? or how am I able to stand and move my hands at the same time?

The above steps which I have mentioned are the major adoption points to generate kindness in heart and empathizing the world in-front of us

Never blame someone or yourself when you are trying to love the person you love that most. Remember to remember them, help others, think about how you can improve the world around you and get busy in changing your thoughts.

If you feel difficulty in following the above steps to be kind and you still want to break the conventional methods that are hurting you,

  1. Give your life to the hands of the Subconscious mind: this is the key to change your life. When you leave challenging tasks to your subconscious mind, one way or the other, you will get a solution. You just have to ask for it. If you don’t ask for the solution, you never get one.
  2. Try to break your daily routine: Breaking the loop is an effective one to do when we don’t get answers in life. Instead of getting ready to work, go for a movie in the morning show, visit shopping malls and do some window shopping.
  3. Travel solo for a day or two: Take leave for 2 days from work if you need to and refresh yourself. Go somewhere out of state and come back after 2 days. When you see new people and their culture, it expands your creative side of your brain and helps you to get a unique way of thinking.

Following life in a way where you find all the joy and kindness that prepares you to lead a life in a way that helps others and yourself to grow. Kindness does not only help you to change your life, but it also affects your surroundings, people, you and everything that is connected to you.

Kindness is a part of the connective journey

Kindness is not just about being humble or being polite it is the nature of humans to get work done with our environment. As we all know about karma and Karmic debts. In the book, “Secrets of Karma” author Vee Jay Attri clearly stated that everything in the universe is connected. How we are can change the whole complexion of the world and also we can inspire the world with the things we do. It seems to be in minute amount but it affects largely.

Consider you are an artist of a guy who uses social media regularly. You never know al the people who comment on your posts or thoughts, but still, they like you and get inspired by your words. You will never get to know their story perhaps, you even don’t know you are the one who changed their life for good. This is how we all connected anonymously in this world of technology where it is helping humans to stay more connected than ever.

If you are being kind in your life, people around you will change and start to be like you. Maybe you are unaware of the things that are happening but, it affects your surroundings by your vibe.

The secret is the law of attraction, kindness works on top of this principle. The secret is a book by Rhonda Byrne, In The Secret, she explains with simplicity the law that is governing all lives, and offers the knowledge of how to create — intentionally and effortlessly — a joyful life.

Conclusion

We live life in a way that attracts others. maybe it is negative or positive inspirations but one way or the other, we always attract each other. Being kind is a part of life where we can make the world around us better and connect with it naturally. The whole universe is there to support our thoughts no matter what it is.

Letting the universe to connect with us is how we can stay motivated and do good things that take our humanity to the next level.

When we arrive in the balcony or world, all we see is the ends of universe and the real beauty in it. We witness infity of horizon and kindness is a tiny star that brings us the joy to enrich our freedom. Deep down we all have kindness but in a different way.

Be Kind and Courageous, This article is also published in harithsa.substack.com

title: The First Day at My Work
description: How I felt on the day when I traveled to another state as the first day of my professional life
imageAlt: A simple briefcase beside an open doorway, with a fine railway line leading to a distant city; the first day of professional life in a new place.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
How I felt on the day when I traveled to another state as the first day of my professional life

It has been a wonderful time in my life. Starting to play it with goodness and riches of my mind. After everything that has been happened in my life, I want to share some of my stories that led me to understand life and improve as a better person.

This article is about the first day of the experience I had at my work. The first company that I worked as a Technical Support Engineer at Convergys for Microsoft process. This was the first time I had a real job in my hands after my own company failed to grow because of the bad choices we have made.

I never wanted to join for a job that needs 9 hours of our day and at the end of the month, we would be waiting for the salary. Sometimes life forces us to live life like that to teach us something about the world we are living in. I went on to start a company before my graduation got completed, and worked as an adult when there was a time I could live life to its fullest in my student career. This is where I committed the first mistake and later without any industry experience, I dive into the ocean of entrepreneurship without a lifeboat.

Working as an employee to any employer helps you to build industry experience and this aids any young entrepreneurs in decision making in own venture and also about their career.

Working under a person is not as bad you think. When I joined Convergys, the first day was about anxiety and fear about how the culture would be and what am I gonna do with their style. At the induction, people started to scare us with all the protocols to follow and a zero-tolerance policy. I was wondering how am I going to follow those rules as I never had any interest in them. At that time I had no choice but accepting whatever the rules they imposed, to follow. I started following it with some scare and also tried being responsible.

At the end of induction, there comes our communication trainer to pour water on the burning fire. He was so short that I had to bow completely to see him. I’m 6.2ft and he may be around 4.5ft or 5ft. He started his intro session and he felt scary as well. He was being so strict as I thought myself that it is difficult for me to survive here even for a week.

I came back home after work, it was almost night and we were instructed to join the training from the next day for evening shift i.e. 5:30 PM to 3:00 AM.

The second day was impressive for me. When we all sat in the training hall, our communication trainer took the class and he was so friendly that to this day even after me leaving the company after two months, he is my life trainer and my mentor.

The biggest takeaway from this job I had, was not to judge at the first shot. If I had stereotyping myself with their words as they are strict and I’m gonna quit, I never would have met the person I admire the most. He is so awesome that positivity travel around him. Whenever I need a suggestion, I go and ask him and in an instant, it makes me free from sadness.

The first day again

I restarted my job after leaving my first company for good. This time, I got an upgrade as a software engineer. To get this job, I worked continuously for 3 months to learn about Dynatrace. As I did a few tasks, fortunately, I got my first project which I needed to go out of state. With all the determination, I chose to go with this path in life where I clearly understood the things happening in my life. I paused my hunt for success and concentrated toward learning and getting experience by understanding the world I live in.

When I went to the place of our customer, on the first day — I was broke and lacked confidence. My heart was beating fast. It was the first time I ever went out of my hometown. I was wearing Formals that made me sweat till my shirt was soaking with it. The weather of the place was so horrible for me that it made me completely uncomfortable. Whatever, I had to deal with that situation to understand the world and how it works. My role was there as a Consultant is not so small one.

My voice was low at that time, legs were shaking because the people we were talking to are brilliant with their skills and they knew in and out of our tool and I was just a fresher to that tool.

Dynatrace — The AI-based APM (Application Performance Monitoring) software that is designed to monitor all of the infrastructures of an organization.

As time started to progress, I started to be more comfortable and less dominated by the people around me. As my cool nature took the charge, I started to slowly understand what is going on in our sales and services team. Now, I can call myself an unconventional individual in our team. When I got there on the team, there were only 5 to 6 members. But now, we have grown to 20. No matter how huge the team becomes, the first day at work and the experience that I had is quite memorable. I just feel to start over that day again and again because the people who were there with me are not there now.

Remember, the first day at the office is always one of the best memorable days in your life. We often consider ourselves as experts in something but this day teaches us how to be good learners. No matter how good you are technically or you have plenty of experience, the culture differs from one to another. Some companies are versatile, some are loaded with protocols. It will only make sense when we use our inner strength to the fullest to learn whatever we can.

Workplace is the school of professionals where we see about life that has communication, people and thoughts which roams around your mind. Every company has its own brilliance that needs to be explored, treated and learned — create a success story and be in touch with people you admire the most.

Keep Reading, Keep Learning. Also published in linkedin.com and harithsanotes.substack.com

title: Likings of Karma
description: Consider the past as your enemy and future as your unpredicted challenge
imageAlt: A small seed drops into water and its ripples connect to a second growing seed; the consequences of everyday actions.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Recently, I am trying to help myself by embracing different stories and new twists of life. When I went to my Aunt’s house for a visit I saw a few books arranged in the rack. “Secrets of Karma” by Vee Jay Attriattracted my eye and I took that book out and started reading. To understand the complete situation I was in while reading this book was unstable. There were a lot of misunderstandings in my family and that got resolved with a simple conversation when the truth got revealed. I was also in the transition of forgetting the greatest disaster of my life but yet, I fell short in understanding the reason why that happened to me.

I took 3 days to complete this book and spent around 6 hours to read the whole book. In this book, it is mentioned about our fate irrespective of all the religions around us. This book is a guide to all of the humans around to know about Karma and wrongdoings of human nature.

I like to make this short and better as a summary of the book and my experience that I have felt. The first part of the Karma is that “what we sow, we reap in our future.”

Our life is connected to millennials and we are not just people who take birth and lead a life then end it. Life is a journey of the soul and it is immortal. During our days we live here, all the sin or good deeds we do in this life will be laid down to zero but if we fail to repay for our mistakes in this life, we need to pay for our sins in our next life with a multiplier effect.

Self-Centric

Sometimes we suffer from life very much and it breaks us down to the deepest of our fears. Even when we are good to others and always wished for others to be happy. This is not because you are unlucky, this happens due to the mistakes we did in our past life and for we are paying our taxes in this life with more interest. We do mistakes knowingly or unknowingly but still everything counts and nothing goes unpaid in this universe.

No debt will go unpaid in this universe

Furthermore, we reap what we sow. If we plant a seed of good deeds, good will happen in our life. If we think of bad and plant bad seeds, we are the ones who will tale complete advantage of the crops we have grown. It is similar to our thought of what we plant in our subconscious mind. Karma works insimilarlyThrough our actions, we dictate our Karma. No matter what happened, now we have to start doing things that bring us a better life in the future or our next life.

Consider the past as your enemy and future as your unpredicted challenge. Leave your enemy behind and prepare for the challenges you are about to face without procrastinating about outcomes or ruminating about what happens.

Responsibility:

Karma attracts us even when we fail to complete our responsibility in life starting from, family, job, gratitude, country and as a human being.

Everything counts in this universe. When we start doing mistakes in our life, it starts upsetting the balance of positive and negative changes in life. When that happens, life starts us to teach about the mistakes we have done by throwing challenges in our life.

In this universe, everything will be counted and we are born to learn and live. Every time we take birth, our learning starts and gets the new chapter to adapt. What we call it as the soul remains the same so does our values from other lives we lived in the past.

Handling our responsibility in every life we born, is very important. Critically, politicians have got the highest priority in that. If they get corrupted, they need to pay for Karma in their next life if they fail to pay in this.

Responsibilities toward family, friends, country, and job also play an important role. If we fail to achieve that in this life, there will be chances where the same thing happens for us in the future.

Responsibilities are connected virtually. Every action or decision we make affects others around us. Every matter in this universe is dictated by moments. Every moment is linked to every other moment. If we clap our hands here can affect the explosion somewhere in the universe. The mysteries of how karma works is an enigma of life.

Misunderstandings

Karma is counted for us even if we cause trouble indirectly to any others like using pirated software brings losses to the manufacturer may be in the amount of 1/1000th time but still, we share that Karma and as the time passes on, this multiplier effect takes place and leads to real Karma.

The multiplier effect is the kind of Karma where small mistakes can cause you long term damage unless it is paid early. For example, people who are frustrated with this life and think of committing suicide is an act of multiplier. It just doubles the Karma and carries over happens to the next life leading to have a life with no legs or any catastrophic life.

Hence, it is important to live our life to the fullest. Whatever the mistakes we do in this life, can be paid off within this life itself without causing any harm.

Purpose

We born on this planet for a reason and we have to learn every reason for our existence. Life is a teacher and the only purpose of our birth is to learn whatever we can no matter how hard it is. We can even think this as a game that never gets over unless we decide it to be.

Our true purpose in this life is to learn and learn as much as we can. Instead of gossiping, hurting and criticizing others, we can lead our life to have a purpose to help others grow. Bringing change in our life that generates good deeds and positive energy around us.

Measures to pay-off the debts of Karma

We can neutralize Karma by doing good deeds in our life. We are sent out to learn and explore in this life. Every day, Every minute we spend, we ought to learn something new or something different. In this journey of our learning, we need to help others to learn and grow.

Try doing good for society this will generate you good Karma and helps you to pay for your mistakes fast. We all know in our religion books it is written to spend 10% of our income to do good for society. That 10% makes a huge difference to someone else’s life. As there is a multiplier effect for bad Karma, there is a multiplier for good ones as well. More good deeds you complete, quicker your bad Karma pays off.

These are the ways that you can often adapt in your life to pay off bad Karma:

  • Gratitude: Always show some respect to the people around you no matter who they are.
  • Love: Love the people from the heart without any obligations or hatred.
  • Forgiveness: Forgive those who have hurt you and don’t curse anyone at any cost.
  • Avoid using free services: It is not about money, if you get service for free, pay something as a donation — this may be your service or the money that helps them.
  • Talk with Good Words (No Profanity): Speak with others politely — even with yourself. Showing kindness increases the positivity around you and brings our environment to a good balance.
  • Bless Everyone: Blessing is not only for elders. We do have a responsibility to wish or bless other people. Keep blessing better things to the world as we are all connected — every atom in this universe is connected.

Conclusion:

We all do mistakes in life and doing mistakes are inevitable. From stepping out to sleep at night, we do countless mistakes that we can reap forever but there are times we do good to this world as well. The universe only demands the balance of good and evil. Balancing them is in our hands. When evil takes up the world, goodwill starts itself to balance.

Unless we learn to be good and do good in life, the universe will act on our behalf. Once we take the responsibility of balancing bad with the good, Karma always is our friend.

Do mistakes but learn from it and once you realize that as a mistake, balance it by doing good deeds and helping others who got hurt by your mistakes. Asking sorry for your mistakes generates a whole lot of good Karma in your life. Understanding what others going through, makes you a better person. Bad Karma never catches you when you are good and follow the balance of the universe.

Happy Reading and Keep doing good in life. Also published in harithsanotes.substack.com

title: Memories — No More Titles Required
description: Memories are the impactful non-living creature that arcs and dips on crests and troughs of life.
imageAlt: An open photo album with blank soft-colour frames and a tiny paper boat on its page; memories moving through life's crests and troughs.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
As a human being, I have always been a part of something that made me curious. Recently my curiosity turned to knowledge and I started to read more and turned that curiosity into habits. It is still hard for me to maintain in my everyday life when professional work populates my day.

These practices that I am following are helping me to keep my memories strong and flexible. As we know, our mind is an extraordinary part that stores, responds and manages all the information that we receive in our daily life. In this article, let’s crack it open to understand, how much memories matter in our life and how it affects us to live out life and our organs to work so tirelessly.

Memories has 2 pathways,

  1. Memories that have unpleasant feelings.
  2. Memories that have good feelings.

Most of the time with the given time, memories with unpleasant feelings fade away or never told publicly. This is because we forget them or there is a probability that we feel sad even if we remember them. The second one is a little different, memories that have good feelings are quite exceptional ones. It will never fade away unless we choose to forget them. It always stays in our life in every step by reminding how we felt at the time.

Preserving memories are important and this is mostly an experience that cannot be explained. One’s memory can be shared with others but it can never be experienced. As human beings, we can choose to live our life with love filled with memories or with achievements that are filled with struggles.

My Story

I am not saying that achievements don’t have emotions or memories, I am saying that having love in our life helps us to accumulate lots of memories that are filled with emotions. Once we set to work hard and dedicate our lives to focus on goals, we can only see the pathway of those goals not the memories and emotions around it.

In our journey, we can take the chance to love someone as well as achieving our goals along the way. I have a small experience in my life related to it. I have a friend who is best of all and my most loved person in my life, we both set out to achieve great things in life. We stayed together for 3 years. We walked, rode, searched, traveled and dreamt of achieving big and accomplishing great things. When things started to feel good, we started to work toward setting our career and concentrated on earning money rather than hitting the bullseye and build the network of people that earns us respect.

We left everyone around us and neglected their words of experience. Earned experience and lost our life in between. Things started to work for us well but by the time we understood our mistakes, it was too late to go back and start over. We just paused the focus toward our goal. That pause led us to a complete failure that burned our company to ashes. After that, we both went our separate ways by burying those good memories inside our hearts.

She stopped understanding me and I stopped talking to her. That beautiful story of us where we never left each other for a moment even when we had no food to eat, no place to stay and no one to console. Sometimes it is hard to forget this kind of memory. My shoulders were her couch and her hands were my healer of pain at the hardest times. We refused to give up on each other even the whole world gave up on us and pushed to the gutter. I remember this memory every day of my life. Those beautiful moments when we were eating ice-cream at the time after we fight and asking sorry to each other. I still remember those times when I was stubborn to eat pizzas. I was acting like I got sick just to demand her to buy me a pizza to eat. Those times when we went shopping for clothes, I was the one finalizing her dresses and she was selecting clothes for me. The times we also ate Panipuris at the roadside. The time when I came back from Mumbai after 20 days of staying away from her, her eyes were filled with tears and the hug that stamped in my head forever as the sweetest and the beautiful memory of my life. We never stopped loving each other and still, we do. Due to some consequences, we had to get separated. We will never see or talk to each other again in life.

This memory of mine includes the sweetest and the hardest as well. But, when time passes and we live each day, only happy memories exist by chipping off bad ones. The coolest memory gives us strength and the love we feel from those memories are the real motivators that help us to succeed in life. Making those memories as a basement, we can build any kind of buildings that stands tall even when disaster happens in life. Storing memory out of love is the best thing to move on in life and building life that helps people around us.

Love makes us weak as well. It is a distraction for life to achieve. But when that love turns into a memory, it becomes the foundation of success. We also call this as positive disintegration — It is the situation that occurs to the person when he/she undergoes immense pain due to love — similar to break up.

Find the path that works better in life. Preserve memories that matter to you and remove those that caused you pain. Forgive those who caused the pain and learn from the experience. Think life like a mathematical problem — good memories are the constants that balance both sides of the equation that lead to the equilibrium. Choose the constant that balance your life that grows. Always keep good memories and leave bad ones or give it some time so that it will fade away itself.

How to accelerate the removal of bad memories?

To remove bad memories of the past, all you have to do is to follow these simple steps. These worked for everyone who I told about and for me as well.

  1. Start Meditating every day
  2. Forgive the person every day
  3. Visualize the situation and consider yourself in their situation

Meditation is the most effective stage but it takes time to compare to the other two. Visualization is the powerful and the fastest way to forgive a person and let go of the bad memory. Forgiveness is the middle of both. When all 3 followed each day, this gives exceptional results. You can start seeing results in a week.

Once it is done, if we are consistent and cultivate this as a habit, we start to be better versions of ourselves each day.

Suggestion: Forgiving a person doesn’t mean you have to talk to them. Talking to them again will push you back in the loop of those memories.

Live life with memories that matter. Forgetting memories are almost impossible to ask. You can only control the thoughts about the memories. Learning to control them is a task that can be achieved by forgiving yourself and others. If it is a good memory, preserve the person and the moments you spent with them forever. Sometimes, teardrop for that person is not a bad thing as well.

Never stop loving the person you love the most because, their memories are the ones that keep you in check with your focussed goals. It doesn’t matter who stays with you, only matters is that memories of the person is in your heart as long as you are alive.

Thanks for reading and please follow to see more of the articles like this in the future. Feel free to share your memories with me. I love to interact with people who share and express themselves.

This article will also be published in harithsa.xyz and harithsanotes.substack.com

Keep reading and preserve good memories.

title: Being an Idiot is not an Irresponsible Thing
description: Sometimes, we need to be an idiot to be curious and to touch the untouchables in other words, crazy enough to change the world.
imageAlt: An upside-down light bulb on a small ladder, with a playful inquisitive ink path reaching an unexpected star; curiosity and the freedom to look foolish.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
There is a say about many resources that are available which are helping to change our mind, “Think of Win-Win situation.” It is always a task for us to specify what we need and how we go about it. Today I am about to write about being an idiot doesn’t make you bad or irresponsible. Sometimes stupidity and idiotic behaviors of our mind are like entertainment to suppress our sadistic part from affecting our positive feelings.

Have you ever observed how our mind reacts to the situation when we are uncomfortable or at the time when we feel about the person we are talking to seems more intelligent than us? We start to think about ourselves as not worthy to be extroverts or to share what we feel at that moment. The fear grows inside and outside we become the index of life that teaches us how to adapt.

My mind always tries to be deceptive when it comes to tackling the people who I don’t k ow much about. It is important for us to understand and directs our minds to lead us to make the best decision at the moment. Instead of feeling scared to open up, start being stupid and worry for nothing else. This helps you to cover your tracks and to care for no one. 2 types in being idiotic help us to grow or it can be the reason for our downfall.

Stupidity is the lack of knowledge about something that we are doing. Idiotic behavior is the actions that we perform even with the knowledge about what’s going to happen. There are different meanings in the dictionary for those but as we use these two words in our lives, we can relate to the definition.

When it comes to the person you love, you always need to be an idiot to make the moments special and to count. Stupidity only deteriorates the relationship. There is happiness at the moment where you are being an idiot with the person you love. It is never irresponsible either. When you kindle, tease or remember the times you spent with the person you love the most or eating your favorite food with the best person of your life by fighting with her before eating the food to make that person understand how much special it would be for you to eat with her when she agrees to eat with you having those idiotic expressions in the face filled with lots of love and care, is out of this world and for those situations our mind must be idiotic to rejoice the moments and store those memories in you harddisk that never gets deleted until the day of your funeral.

When it comes to working, being an idiot is a smart thing. When your boss insists you to take up all the work, instead of piling those it is better to be an idiot to show him that you only know certain things to work for and rest are out of your boundary. This is called smartness. Idiotic behavior helps you to cover you. Always being an idiotic person may not work well because it involves pretending and ignoring a few things. It is better to be smart in being idiotic as well.

Set some ground rules on when and where you need to apply this skill to prevail. Here are a few things where you can apply or you can start being an idiot:

  1. While being an essentialist.
  2. When you are with the person you love and you wanted to prove to them that you are blunt and she is smarter than you.
  3. At the time when you face an uncomfortable situation and you want to deal with it softly.

These 3 situations are the best place where you can start being an idiot. Later as you follow these ground rules, you will discover yourself about where you need to open yourself and where you need to pretend.

Advanced Ideology:

When you decide to go on a mission to change the world, you may get stuck somewhere in between moving forward and staying in the present. This is because of the skeptical mind you have. Developing a situation or the brain to tackle the fearlessness by keeping your anxiety under control will help you to move forward.

In the middle of life where your business fails and you had to change tracks, being an idiot is the best thing to learn more about the things that you don’t know — Start to think about yourself as a person who knows nothing even though you know something — this ideology helps you to learn other business rules and get new career opportunities that enrich your current business.

There is a situation where you need to unlearn a few things where you think you are the best. Start to learn things that help you to get along with people — you can call it as people skills.

Being an idiot cant be an irresponsible thing when you start applying it to the right place and at the right time.

Love, Business and Failure are the places where you need to be like an idiot. This dogma can take you to a long way of being better at learning about humans and to discover your inner within. There is always a success present in being a person who holds his knowledge to learn something new. In this article, I’d like to call those people who are crazy, ignorant and always loves to learn more and more like idiots. Being one like that is a good thing and maybe one of the steps to change the world in the right way — to train the mind in the focussed path.

Be an Idiot and Keep Learning Forever

Originally Published at The Harithsa Notes (harithsanotes.xyz)

title: What Happened After Crushing My Dream?
description: Things I have done after becoming ineligible for the dream I held from day one of my living
imageAlt: A cracked compass rests beside a fresh branching path and a sunrise; rebuilding direction after a cherished dream is lost.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Ever since I learned to understand, I faced with choices that were inevitable to reject them. The consequences that everyone faces in this world are quite different and instrumental. The life we choose to live is always will be different from what we were expecting at the start. My life started similarly like that. It all happened 25 years ago where my mom suffered 2 nights continuously to get me out of her womb. From day one my entry to this planet was not so great. I born with pain and the pain just simply vanished when she held me in her hands for the first time. Instead of pain, she felt happy and satisfied with accomplishment the greatest fact of human life that is to giving birth.

This happens to every woman. They feel happy when they see their baby. All the pain fades away and the sense of happiness would be unexplainable. Later she had to let me go and I grew up in my grand father’s house. In there I learned so many things. My home was the university for me to learn and develop all kinds of habits which are good, bad and hard. I use to taught by my mom about science and religion. The comparison between them was questionable every time. I use to question about religion and was comparing similarly like that with science on what if..??

I was on my top about researching, learning and asking questions to my teachers and learning from them. Till my 12th grade, I use yo think like a scientist. My only aim was to become one and to what is going on in the world. I am not a creative kind of person, I do question when I feel mysterious before accepting and add my thoughts to that concept to understand them well. I was more of a theorist.

I completed my 12th grade and it was the time for me to choose my path. I said to myself, “I’m. 18 now, buddy. It’s your life and you are the maker of your destiny so go hard and strike hard the mysteries.” till now these are the best words that I said to myself till now. Later when I applied for the under graduation course on Aeronautical Engineering, I got a seat in a college where I had to move out of my hometown to study for it.

I constructed dreams that day by thinking I can do this, I will be an Astrophysicist or an Astronaut. I was inspired by Kalpana Chawla. Her death inspired more to have the hope to become an astronaut.

When I went for a discussion about the same with others, they told that I am not fit to become an astronaut because my eyes are not well developed. I have 50% of the vision along with myopia. That was the day I realized that I am not thinking straight. I never thought about the prerequisites required to become an astronaut. My heart broke completely and I was depressed like my life is over. The next try was to become a scientist. That was the 2nd best option I had. Hence, I went back to another college and applied for Bachelors’s in Astrophysics — fortunately, I got a seat in that as well. Once more I had to move out of my hometown if I accept the offer.

This time my mom prevented me from getting into the college out of our hometown. I never blamed for that because I was living in my grandfather’s house. He was dead already and he had 2 wives always fighting for the places. My step-grandmother started to betray my mom and my grandmother. This has been a lot involved when it comes to the things that I processed at that time. We were so inspirational to others before that, everybody was telling us that to stay with 2 wives and children in the same house is an exception. People appreciated the unity.

Everything in our life dies. The same happened to me. So, I was not able to move to the city at that time and stayed with my mom and went for a college. I choose to study Information Science. I joined engineering.

Guys like me are always shattered in life when we don’t get what we wished for but at that time it has become a habit more than disappointment. My life was in transition through the day I stepped into this world.

There is a reason for me to share this story with you all. I want to guide the people or make them understand that the world is not about to end so soon and we have a lot of options if we don’t get what we wished for. Sometimes we get better than that. Recently, I left the best person of my life indefinitely. I got so hurt and disappointed by the things she did to me after we were together for a complete 3 years without being apart for a single day. I was feeling like forever when she was not there with me even for a minute or two. That is how we were attached and as soon as she found another person, she decided to keep me away and started to prioritize him.

This is how this world works. When we wish for only a single thing to happen in our life, that will never gonna happen. The thing or the person we love will not support us to grow. There are chances where out of a million people, 10 or 20 friendships we can find but not more than that. People change, situation change, your dreams shatter, things will break, at last, you will break as well. This is not bad and you cannot blame the person or the situation for your suffering. The choices you make in your life matters and they are connected. So, the past is not in our hands and the future always needs to be written by your present actions.

When I joined engineering, from day one I started to develop an interest in computers and to help people. I tried helping my institution, they told me I am not qualified to help them. After 2 years of continuous research, I tried to implement a cloud service on our campus. They just turned down my pitch and gave that to our faculty to do it. They were half successful though. I faced difficulty and failure in the things that I was not able to convince others to accept my ideas because I haven’t accepted their way either. As long as there is friction in agreeing to terms and not thinking about doing whole well to society, we as humans personally cannot grow or develop self-awareness. We need to accept the difficulties and have to apply the alternatives when we fail to achieve the primary things.

Now, it is working great for me even though I am not a scientist. The mind what we have is important. I opted to become a scientist because my mind was full of questions that wanted to go for the pursuit of answers. I get questions even now on business, education, growth of society, politics and computers. The day my dream was crushed from becoming a scientist or an astrophysicist, it started to reach all the areas including science. I started to write, read different books, started to learn to program, expanded my mind to work on photography and now professionally an IT guy.

This is how life takes us. When we are not able to go forward in the direction, we hoped for at least we can use our same brain to expand our areas and apply the same energy into those areas. Now, I am writing sitting on the 21st floor by thinking, if I get a chance to change the world, what would I do. My answer is, I will make everything for free and tell people to complete the tasks to get what they want. If they want an iPhone, they must build an iOS app and publish it to the App store or they need to support people in living their lives. There has to be a trade but not the money in it. I still challenge myself and I am starting to give services like Website Development, SEO, Digital Marketing and Software Development for free. I starred this change myself. I won’t have time to do 1000 websites a day but I can do 1 and give services to them. This builds the network among us.

Pure humanity must be tapped to remind our self conscious that we are not the slaves of 7 sins. We need to stand together and now I am starting alone by hoping someday the world around me will change. No matter how difficult it is, once we know the value of love, hatred, betrayal, we understand how important it is to be with people around us who are the same.

Tapping into the pure human nature is different than just surviving, earning money or fame. It is again different from enjoying life being introvert. Pure humanity grows when we grow amd mentor others to grow with us. When that happens, our growth never stops but when opposite happens, the time we grow above people, our growth simply stops by telling us this is enough and there is nothing more.

Live life that does make sense, keep thinking and never stop dreaming about good things.

title: The Power of Little Finger and Legs
description: When do you ask your hand a question, which is the greatest of all fingers? Why do you feel bad when you got kicked by one’s leg?
imageAlt: One tiny stone forms the essential keystone of a large elegant arch; overlooked parts becoming sources of strength and significance.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
I have been arguing, dealing and consenting about different ways to give a message for all of us and understanding the difference between the lower class and upper class. Precisely, I just want to consider everything is there at its own level and all are important. We can’t bifurcate between poverty and richness, good and bad, civilized and uncivilized, head and leg, strong and weak or thumb finger and little finger. It is insane to compare fish and monkeys. We all should know that.

The main point I am trying to convey here is, if there is a competition of strength and specialty between, head and toe or thumb and little finger, we cannot say which one is better. So let’s consider a story of, i) Fingers, ii) Body — Fingers story is about competition between all the fingers in our hand, and — Body’s story is about competition between upper body and lower body discussing the importance of their presence. Upper body, insults the lower part without knowing the greatness of it, “Man Lives Above and Legend Lives Downunder.”

Let’s read the stories of it. It might be a religious war but that makes sense to understand the knowledge and make your read worth a while.

Story of Fingers:

We all know, to have 5 fingers Thumb Finger, Fore Finger, Middle Finger, Ring Finger, and Little Finger. Let those 5 fingers be 5 persons. Their name would be, T, F, M, R, L

  • Mr. T — Thumb
  • Mr. F — Fore
  • Mr. M — Middle
  • Ms. R — Ring
  • Mr. L — Little

Mr. T says, “I am the strongest and I need nobody to support me and I am the primary person to perform the tasks in daily lives.”

Mr. F says, “I am the one who instructs someone to do things. I am the pointer whom you cannot replace. I am different and unique than most of all.”

“If I ever show up and point at someone, you all will be ruined and I am the tallest of you all.” Mr. M laughs and expresses.

Ms. R with all her charms of beauty rose her voice, “I am the most beautiful than you all. You guys need to brace yourselves. I am the main person in your marriages and with me, your efforts will be futile.”

“Great, here it goes we all are important for a cause or the other, but what is your function, Bullock.” kindled by all of the above and asked Mr. L.

Mr. L with a grim face felt sad and kept quiet sometimes. But 4 of them kept humiliating him.

Finally, Mr. L after exactly 4 hours, started talking politely, “I’m looking at the side where I am useless, guys. Even if I am not there it doesn’t make any sense. But, when you want salute someone or to greet somebody of higher class or to show respect, I am the one who shows gratitude to their attitude and personality. My intentions are never vague. When you have to feel the beauty of the river and drink water from it, I will be the one who drowns in the water and drive those small chunks of water into the palm. I pickup things first.”

“I simply represent respect. My behavior determines the prospect of others. Sometimes, children use me to convey that they have to go for a pee.” humorously with a smile in face explained.

“In greeting special people of our life or strangers or while praying, we bow and to do that we use both hands. That time while doing ‘Namaskara’ I come first and you guys stand behind me no matter how special you are. Even when you are saluting army personnel or to your country flag, My presence comes first and behind me, you all will follow.” Says Mr. L with that humbleness in his face.

Takeaway:

We read what they discussed and in the explanation of their jobs and duties, T, F, M, R, L, everybody chose their work and explained. At last, all that matter was the pause that Mr. L took, at last, to explain himself about his function and the importance. Everyone has their own functions and everyone is different from each other but what matters is, how do we convey our presence and the way of presenting ourselves with others explains who we are and how we can stand out in the crowd.

Nobody can be you, there is no one in the history of mankind that there is another you. We just need to know our greatness inside and embrace that greatness with compassion and humility. We don’t get a whole lot of chances to be good in life. Maybe we get 1 chance each day when someone ask you a suggestion, your boss may call for your help, you may get a chance to speak about yourself in your old school or college, an unknown homeless guy asks you to buy him food, or maybe you may ask yourself to be better each day. Embrace all of those opportunities you get daily and act towards it. Never miss a chance when you get to be a good person. Be the one who is worthy to be followed instead of following others and living in other dogma.

One day or the other we all need to bow for one or the other. Even if you are a manager, welcome your employee by telling him, “Thanks for coming to work today, let's change the world.” By holding your hand at the heart and having a smile in your face. You see the difference that he makes in your team and if you do it for all the members in your team, you will see exceptional results. The humbleness comes first and the face which you had your smile, will be remembered all day by your team member. That is what true leaders do.

Let’s drop off to one more story.

Story of Body:

This will be the story of perspective about how we treat lower people in our life by taking a religious example. This will help you to understand how things are considered and how different perspective helps us to understand that we are all down to earth people originated from stardust. One way or the other, we will become what we once were — Elements of Nature.

In the Hindu religion, A human body is considered as 4 different categories defined by their class of work.

  • Head: Symbol of thinking at higher levels and considered as the highest level because of wisdom. Symbol of the guide/teacher. (Brahmin)
  • Shoulders: The torchbearer or the stage of responsibilities where we carry all the strengths to live our life. Symbol of soldier/king. (Kshatriya)
  • Stomach: Symbol of a businessman who executes and digest plans. (Vaishya)
  • Legs: Dirty worker. Symbol of a worker who do all the dirty works without distinguishing either of any differences on the ground. (Shudra)

The point here is, Shudra/Sudra is the 4th and lowest traditional class. But why do we touch our elders' feet to take their blessings? What is the real reason to do that? Even though our upper body (Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya) is considered as the top of everything and they are special? This made me curious to understand. So, I dug deep in Hindu religious teachings.

Many religious leaders teach 4 different castes of the Hindu system as the differences in humans themselves but that is not true. That is made to differentiate from their work not by their genetics. In our ancient culture of gurukuls, A teacher was the one who called as Brahmin because of his saintful abilities and his knowledge. They were guiding kings at that time. Kings/Soldiers who fight for a cause to protect their loved ones or their kingdom are considered as Kshatriya. Vaisha was a trader or the wealthiest person who generates income and revenue by implementing business plans. We can call the Board of members of the council. Finally, Sudra comes as a group of people who were performing tasks for the king like a maid, cleaning, maintenance such as all kinds of cleaning works. Sometimes they ever regarded as the group who do dirty works like cleaning toilets building them or even poor people. These classes of people always bowed to their kings and paying taxes for them — Bowing means not like we are dominated by them. It is the way to show respect for the work they are doing — Kings, Guiders, Business people are smart and do hard work to protect their country so that the poor ones can live a happy life.

This principle of classes in Hindu religion is widely misunderstood by false teachers who divide the beliefs of people and use it for their own good.

To answer my question which I had, I researched more and when any person who bow to their elders to take blessings, mostly we can see in every house of Hindu religion that all the younger people will touch the feet of their elders with their 2 hands and the head to show them respect. But to show them respect, they touch the feet itself which are considered as sudra by our religion. Religious fanatics suppress the sudra category as the low graded people. Touching feet of the person means that we are showing the gratitude and the heavy lifting they are taking to survive in this world. Sudra the part is responsible to live an independent life by a person without depending on any others.
