Touching feet is the symbol of us telling that person, “I am completely into you and I am grateful for your wisdom and experience. I would like to learn from you as much as I can so please bless me with your charm.”

The gratification point here is, we tell each other that nobody are great and the views that people had toward sudra class is not true. Finally, we show our respect to the part which is considered as sudra in our body but why people think in a different way and suppress religion into 4 types instead of separating them with the work they do?

That is what every religion has on this planet. Religion gets deteriorated when people with less wisdom start to teach millions. Dalai Lama from Buddist religion is the people to consult if you want to know about Buddhism. Fathers and Bishops for Christianity, Sufi Saints for Muslims, for Hindu religion there are thousands of babas considered as greats but very few of them are really rare. This is where Hinduism is getting diluted by bad perception and conveying real teaching in a false way. The real teacher is the one who teaches the values of religion in the right way and expecting nothing from it. As I went on to talk about Hinduism with more people who are true followers of it, they say that it is the oldest and the basic religion that was found by humanity and later other religions took birth based on the teachings and different perspective.

When we see the world as to how it is and the reasons for the principles that are governing us, those principles or protocols are designed for a purpose. If those protocols are taught in an untruthful way, real wisdom of knowledge fades away from humanity.

Conclusion:

In this article, I tried to convey 2 messages for our life. There is a life with positive thinking and the influence we need to think positively is, the true perspective. Values and Purposes need to be taught in a truthful way instead of false wisdom.

When we see life as it is, we can be positive. When we ask our instincts to behave as it is with what it is designed for, we understand the true meaning of life.

Humanity grows with the power of togetherness and the knowledge that has been conveyed. We are not immortals. We live our life once and nobody will remember us. The only way we are remembered by the teachings or the research we leave behind. The research you do can drive humanity forward or with the false directions, it can pull us back. So leave a legacy in life that is true. Your work lies in the significance you leave behind.

title: An Acoustic Mind — The Song of Art
description: How the mind of an artist should be and how adorable it is to be with an artist
imageAlt: A violin outline becomes a flowing ink brushstroke across an artist's blank canvas; the artistic mind and music.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
The art. What do we know about art when we say it is the science of mind that defines the process of getting things done? “Hell, yeah. It makes sense.” Being different and the ability to see the unseen in every aspect of life is called art. It generally stays in humans. We also can observe spiders that construct their web, Insects get together to carry food, Monkeys dance and act like mindless. In every action of living organisms, art is infused and the way the observer sees that activity is also an art.

When it comes to humans, we live each day as we live our life eternally by believing in the things that capture the depth of attention to detail. There is an ordinance to our brain. It works like a machine to non-artistic things. Generally, when we are creative we can observe the broadness that presents in our minds. The title of this article is, “An acoustic mind” which explains about art that is present in our minds.

How to extract the artistic, creative part of our brain that is working or while we are watching movies or when we are talking to someone? The answer is quite simple, just think like an artist. But, How to think like an artist? Again, the answer is easy for this. Start being like an artist. How to be like an artist? Answer for this is, start seeing things that others can’t see. You need not be gifted to become an artist. All you need is Patience.

I lived my life for 3 years with an artist and understood each step how they invent when they work. She was my best friend and I lived with her for 3 years. I am not an artist to observe every creator’s move but here are the things I observed from her. She is the best artist I have known to date.

  1. Artists are Lazy.
  2. They are incredibly well versed in their skills.
  3. They arrange things well.
  4. They will never get satisfied with the static arrangements. They always change directions and positions of their collections.
  5. They like to shop and always keep pencils with them.
  6. They are the huge lovers of drawing books and pens. Especially, black ink pens. (Waterproof)
  7. Their minds are always like a child. Hard to convince but it is cute to watch their stupidity.
  8. They live in their world and worried about none.
  9. They don’t need any inspiration to draw or to paint. When they pick up brushes or crayons, the power of art simply talks in their masterpiece.
  10. Final attribute and the most adorable, they have tremendous patience and focus when they draw even if it is for a min or two.

For Non-Artists:

Whatever I learned about art in my life, I just witnessed people who are creative and call themselves that. I am the worst artist. Whenever I take a pencil or pen to draw something, Obama becomes Trump and DaVinci becomes Plato.

There is also one saying, artists are those who build their minds to see things that others can’t see. I never observed or witnessed that philosophy thought. Every human seems to be different for me. Every face has got its value and every mind is the same. How to see artists in non-artistic eyes? This is for the folks like me, I’d rather say just go and talk to unknown and ask their name and Date of birth. Do it for 5 people then you will get to know how different those 5 answers would be. When you can see the difference, think yourself as an artist and for giving unique responses each 5 of them will also become artists. Art is uniqueness and as long as there are people, everyone possess their way. Everyone is artists and anyone can be a great artist if he/she shows great patience and focus toward the things they are doing.

We are the humans, after all, never take away yourself from the vision to see you as an artist. To be creative or to think creative follow these steps:

  1. In a day, focus on something for 60 seconds. Eg. Think only about the person you might want to become in the future and believe yourself as an artist who is creative enough to change the perspective of others and help them to achieve their dreams.
  2. Assume the worst and see the best in it. Eg. Assume the worst has happened to you and there is nothing worse than this to happen. In my case, it is being alone. Then, tune your mind to assume that you are in the middle of 1000 people who care for you. This immediate transition of your brain leads you to think creatively and when the worst happens to you, you will have the ability to come around it quickly.
  3. Draw or paint every day. To improve your focus, try to increase your hand intuitiveness. Leave your hand as free as it gets. Draw something every day to make sure you will never stay out of touch.
  4. Practice calligraphy and try to strike out in a blank sheet of paper as much as you can. This improves the easiness of your hand. When your hand is free, only then you can draw beautiful images.

I came along from a non-artistic to an artistic guide. All these points above I mentioned helps you to lay a foundation on your artistic journey.

Art is not about drawing beautiful pictures. It is about the coordination between your hand and the brain. When you can write what you see, you can be an artist of your kind. It takes a lot of practice and endeavors to get that understanding. An art stamps creativity into your subconscious and makes your life as uniquely yours.

Conclusion:

Try an activity to write every day. Assume your face and try to write in a sheet of paper. It doesn’t matter how bad you draw. Just observe the same after 365, days of continuous effort. You will be writing your face perfectly.

Be Consistent, Patient and Focussed. That is what every artist do. At least my best friend did that in those 3 years. She never left loving art and being like an artist.

title: Tune in to Your Habits
description: When we tag our goals to habits, we can knock the door of infinite power that gives you extraordinary results.
imageAlt: Small repeated footprints follow a circular groove and gradually form a strong gear; turning goals into daily habits.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Here is the thing that we all are hoping to follow. Nost of us face difficulties in cultivating good habits that make a huge difference in our future. That is because our thoughts are instant and expect results as quickly as possible. Our brain has less tendency to wait for results or it cannot be curious for a long time. I’d rather say that this kind of mentality is developed ever since the first human is formed.

After 1000s of years, civilization came to existence and humans became how we are now. We follow rules, we earn, we learn and survive. The basic habitual part of humans is, eat, sleep, survive. On top of these basics, we started to differentiate ourselves as thinkers, achievers, and learners.

Developing habits that make a difference for our future don’t convince us. We need incentives to come out of our basic instincts. To do that, we need to follow a few steps that help us to make these behavior changes.

As part of my reading process, I read this book, “Atomic Habits” authored by James Clear. He mentioned some interesting ways to cultivate any activity into a habit. It takes simple steps to adapt. Here are those steps that might help you to cultivate good habits that make a huge difference to the future.

Steps:

  1. Small changes in life lead to big surprises.
  2. Growth needs to be automated to habits.
  3. Habits must be attached to cues — Implementation Intentions
  4. Reward your tasks — Temptation Bundling
  5. Creating fewer friction rules
  6. Find alternate ways to get instant satisfaction
  7. Creating a framework to track habits

Step 1: Small changes in life leads to big surprises

We don’t concentrate on smaller changes in life. It may seem doesn’t make sense at that time but for the long term, it changes everything for you. In my life when I was in college, I use to eat pizzas every day but the day after day I was thinking like its the last day and that doesn’t change the fact of the future. After a year when I calculated the money I spent on eating them made me wonder that 3 to 4 poor students would’ve completed their whole college with that money.

That thinking gave me some eyeopener feel and I decided to control eating or spending more money. I got sick about that every time I spent money I was regretting it. It almost took me 4 years to change my mind to be sensible in spending money. I tried to control it every day until I found a simple way that worked for me.

I started to spend money to buy gifts for the person I love instead of spending money on myself. That was my cue.

When you can’t see through or control the habits that make you regret, change the direction of it. It takes time to adapt but it will definitely work. For me, it was about finding my cue i.e the person I loved.

Step 2: Growth needs to be automated to habits

Think of habits that you want to cultivate in life. When an activity is done by humans automatically, it becomes a habit and that is governed by the subconscious mind. Activity will be pushed to the background like the Async task on the computer. To push that activity to your subconscious — like you drink water automatically when you are thirsty instead of juice — you should understand the 4 stages of habit, Cue, Craving, Response, and Reward.

Cue is the moment you know what you need to do. Craving is the change of state in you to do the task. The response is the action you perform. And Reward is the aftermath of the action performed, in this case, it is serving thirst after drinking.

To make any activity turned into a habit, you must keep doing it consistently until it is automated. In my case, I started to read 54 days ago and I have been doing it every day since. Apply 21-days rule to any activity. Keep repeating it for 21 days. It will become an automated task by itself. Now, without reading, no day will pass in my life. It has become a normal task like eating food or drinking tea every day.

Step 3: Habits must be attached to cues — Implementation Intentions

We saw how habit helps our long term goal and also we learned how to create one. Now, How do we make that habit a good one by motivating ourselves to achieve?

Let’s take a simple example, drinking water more is a good habit but most of the people fail to drink 8 glasses a day i.e. 2 liters. So to make this habit easy or we need to make sure that we should not come to our conscious to object the thought of doing it. I kept a water bottle on my table beside my workstation so that whenever I see that water bottle or I feel to take a break for a minute or two, the first thing I did was, drinking a sip of water. The same applies to other habits as well.

If you find harder to focus on your work, find a girl who looks pretty. Automatically our mind gets attracted to her and you start to go to work happily without any laziness or procrastinating about it. This applies to students as well.

Implementation intentions are simple, just you need to follow harder work to do your favorite work. Tie the difficult work and the hard work together. For example, I hated creating reports every day in an excel sheet to my customers regarding their application that has reported problems. I had to create 25 to 30 rows at the end of the day. What I did is, I automated that task and my application started reporting each problem in an excel at the end of the day leaving me to look after only about the application fixing the bugs of it. For me, coding is a joy so I love that work but the result is, my customer is also happy that they are getting reports. The author says,

Many people think they lack motivation when what they lack is clarity.

Unlike me, you can find a different activity that is hard and you can tie that activity to your favorite ones. This is very helpful to improve your work and daily routines. Get clarity on what you are doing. For example, instead of insisting yourself planning on competing for the Employee of the year, start by doing good today and work better. Complete the difficult task assigned creatively. If you get an idea for your goal, take action now and do something about it. If you think of completing a book in one week, start reading 2 pages of the book. If you like it, you will automatically go on and complete that book in a week or before that time.

Turning an activity that needs to be done without noticing by our conscious mind, pushes that activity to subconscious stack where upon continuing, we will start to like that activity based on the steps we have performed to get that completed.

Step 4: Reward your tasks — Temptation Bundling

Now we learned how to make habits stick even without getting into our conscious. This is better when it comes to good habits and we need to do exactly opposite to bad ones. We understood that small change will make a big difference so we started to embrace those activities and tried to automate it by pushing it to our subconscious stack. Now, it is time to reward the habits after cultivating it.

How can we reward our habits? How it is better when we reward our habits?

Humans are attracted by rewards when we reward our habits, it makes them stick in our life. This happens when our brain releases Dopamine. This dopamine hit, causes humans to feel good about doing anything. This happens whenever we listen to our favorite songs or spend time with our loved ones.

We can use temptation bundling to reward habits and this comes from the example I mentioned in the above section. I mentioned how I made my habit automated by building an application that generates reports.

If we think about daily habits, for example when I go for a walk I read articles. My instructions about this task are, I love to read and I was failing to walk every day consistently hence I have decided to read when I go for a walk. I found a place outside 1.5 miles from my home to sit and read. Every day I go to that place to read. This has become my routine now. Like this, I do this for listening podcasts as well. I listen to podcasts when I am walking.

Instructing you brain to work like, “If this — than that” helps you to build a platform of good habits in you. Like hitting 2 birds with a stone. When you couple good and hard habits with your favorite habits, results will be astonishing.

Step 5: Creating fewer friction rules

Habits need to be easy and helpful in practice. If you cultivate a habit that takes 3 hours of your day to complete doesn’t make sense. They need to be short and must have less friction to complete. The good thing with this step is, you can apply this to the habits that are bad to remove them.

When you keep drinking water on your table all the time, helps you to stay healthy, not storing wine alcohol at home creates friction. You need to get out to drink instead. As this happens, your brain feels tired of going out every time to get alcohol. When you store fruit juice at home more, instead of going out and drinking alcohol, you tend to drink fruit juice instead. This habit keeps you healthy and far from bad habits.

You can apply this to your productivity at work as well. Cultivate a habit of putting your cellphone as far as possible from your work station and make it hard to reach. Every time you want to check your phone, you have to find it and this creates friction in your mind. Instead of checking the phone you feel to look at the screen of the work station and work on it. Make sure to put your phone in silent mode.

When it comes to good habits, you can always have templates to use when it is needed at work. When your manager asks you to create a report, a predefined template helps you to work faster and easier rather than doing it from scratch. Store greetings with you by organizing them on different occasions. As soon as that occasion comes, pick that greeting and send it to your loved ones. This is far better than going out and purchasing one and then send it to them. Be prepared and plan accordingly to make good habits more enjoyable. This is the first step in being productive.

Another trick we can follow to be productive, the two-minute rule. In our daily lives, we come across a lot of reminders about simple works that we postpone to do it later. Instead of doing like that try looking at them in this way, “If that work takes more than 2 minutes or less than that I am going to do it now. If it takes longer, I will schedule it.” this way of looking at the tasks that cone in our way helps to build the productivity mindset and this habit is one of the keys to success.

It is important to cultivate a good habit and creating an environment that is easy to execute that, always plays an important role to stick it for longer period of time.

Step 6: Find alternate ways to get instant satisfaction

Our brain is trained to see instant results for the work we do as I discussed in the intro of this article. Making our minds to get that satisfaction, we have to find alternate ways by not changing that habit instead of embracing them.

In my life, I tried this way and worked out for me well. My dream is to travel the world within 35. But to achieve this, it is not possible for me now. So, I started to save some money. Whenever I prevent myself from eating pizza, I put that amount of money in my savings account and check the balance of it.

When I think about my traveler instincts, instead of thinking about not going on a world trip, I recheck my account balance. This makes me feel something good about myself about my savings and gives me that hope where I can save more to travel one day.

Also I took this step further to enhance my good habits. I have my routine to follow and whenever I fail to follow that routine like, walking, reading writing, meditating, I pay some money to my Mom for failing to do it. That is my strict rule. If I fail to write that day, I pay Mom 500 bucks.

When I write an article and publish it every day, I feel like I saved 500 and I get an immediate feeling of accomplishment and satisfaction for completing this routine. It is not about money. When I feel that satisfaction, it makes me write more and be in a loop of my resolution about writing daily.

I didn’t believe this step before but, when it started to work for me, It all changed. From writing 2 articles per week, I write 8 times a week. This changed the way how I work on my habits. This is because I don’t want to say I failed in front of my Mom.

When we have clarity on the habit, we often tend to experiment with them and make them strong to stick in ourselves. Hence, it is important to make that habit a good one.

Step 7: Creating a framework to track habits

This is a very powerful step to perform after Creating, Automating, Inspiring, Rewarding, Easy-ing and Sticking a habit. Tracking habits are similar to getting satisfaction from it.

We can track them by writing journal, arranging them in To-Do lists, looking at the stats, time to time is enjoyable. Placing milestones to achieve them is also a good habit to practice. Listing out all the work you do or you did and keeping them tracking directs your mind to crave for more higher insights to achieve.

I follow all the tracking systems in my everyday life from reading articles to tracking my listening minutes. I evaluate them every month to check my progress. When it says, I have written 20,000 words, I try to increase that count next month. Breaking my records helps me to compete with myself. As long as I compete, I get better with the habits I included in my routine.

Tracking is very important for our brain. It keeps us updated. Think of yourself achieving more everytime when you beat that stat. It will become habitual practice that aids you in real world of competition.

Conclusion:

Habits are the primary part of human beings. When we cultivate it for good reasons, we often do good to the people around us. Follow these 7 steps to convert any activity into a habit. It is important for us to different activities that help us to plan the future from those who give temporary satisfaction. Long term changes exist in bad habits as well. Our health deteriorates when we smoke every day instead of just smoking at that moment. It may not give disease momentarily but it makes a difference if you make it a habit. The immediate pleasure when you get while smoking may seem fair to you but the pieces of immediate pleasure constructed as a mountain that can’t be destroyed after 10 or 20 years.

Steps for cultivating good or bad habits are the same. These 7 steps are like a weapon to save ourselves or to destroy ourselves. When we use it to improve, it gives great results. If we use it to destroy ourselves, nothing can stop us from infecting the people around us.

title: The Power of Subconscious Mind
description: How to harness the power we have by turning goals into habits.
imageAlt: A small visible iceberg above calm water reveals a much larger geometric form below, with a gentle orbit; the unseen subconscious mind.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
When we understand the goal that is being chosen, we instruct our minds to work towards the goal. To work towards a highly competitive mind, we need that power to work on it. The power comes from our subconscious. This article is a consolidation of the book, “The Power of Subconscious Mind” by Joseph Murphy.

In his book, it is mentioned quite beautifully about the power that is sleeping inside us. When we tap into that power with the right tools, the human mind can do impossible things. It is all about mind and its inner strength. How can we tap into that kind of power that our mind has? How does it work? Let’s have a quick read about the book along with my thoughts about it.

Chapters:

  • There is a treasure house within you
  • The subconscious mind is the seat of your emotions
  • The miracle-working power of your subconscious
  • The practical techniques that could bring humans to mental healing
  • How to use the power of your subconscious for wealth
  • The lack of knowledge of the interrelationship of the conscious and subconscious mind brings marital problems

There is a treasure house within you

We all know there are 2 states of our mind. One is subjective and the other one is objective. We can call the objective side as the conscious mind and subjective as the subconscious mind.

Our subconscious mind is responsible for all the backend actions that happen in our bodies. All the automated tasks, impulses, inner body working are maintained by our subconscious mind. Our decision making, present thinking and all monitored by our conscious/objective mind. It is the face of a while mind.

Consider the time before you sleep or you work, when you are in the alpha stage of your mind, try instructing to do good or bad things. At that time, whatever the instruction you give to your mind it will be stamped inside your conscious and subconsciousness. To know more about the stages of the brain between objective and subjective, I suggest you read one of my articles, The Power of 20 Minutes — Goldilocks Duration.

Tapping into the power of subconscious needs practice and that power can be attained mostly by following simple steps. We will be discussing them in this article.

The subconscious mind is the seat of your emotions

Now the author explained in this book about emotions, how effective the subconscious mind can be when it comes to our emotional gain or loses.

The subconscious mind is like a baby. It takes what we feed into it. If we feed good thoughts it will start to execute good outcomes, if we feed it with bad ones, it executes depression, sadness, and loneliness. I can simply say, it amplifies the thoughts that are sent by an objective mind. Generating negative things in our conscious mind leads to frustration, depression and uncontrolled behavior that is caused by the subconscious mind.

The main advantage of the conscious mind is the reasoning, Conscious mind learns from education, experience, and observation whereas the Subconscious mind learns from five senses in our body hence they are called objective and subjective respectively. Our subconscious performs its highest functions when we are asleep meaning when our conscious mind is stopped working, i.e in the Theta stage.

The miracle-working power of your subconscious

The author mentioned the miracle power of the subconscious mind. It is the powerhouse that has infinite power to tap into. This is responsible for all of our actions. Our subconscious mind is the one that started heartbeat and it continues till the end. This part of the brain never sleeps until our death. Our senses are always active. This is responsible for digestion, assimilation, and excretion. Every change in our body is maintained by the subconscious mind.

It is the source of infinite power that needs to be contained with the thoughts and our values. It keeps us in check with all the forces. All the solutions, consequences, desires, goals and our thinking are passed into subconscious when we are asleep that is where all the elements we thought of coming to our dream. Sometimes, scientists get answers to their problems while they are dreaming. It comes as cognitive thinking. We experience the solution that is delivered to us by someone in our dreams. But, that someone is our subjective mind which never stops thinking and it will always be in your service.

It has also the power to digest poison as water when the power of the subconscious is tapped. You will be restored to complete health when you entrust it. It will help your body to neutralize it.

The practical techniques that could bring humans to mental healing

Imagine how miracles happen in life. Think of something you truly want and desire it deeply. Something like you pray for the things that need to happen to improve your life. When you pray for the infinite power, your subconscious has the power to respond to your prayers. It sends help to your conscious mind.

Consider, when you want something so badly and pray for it from your mind deeply, it will be granted to you. When you ask for good things to happen, it will happen. It is not like somebody come and grants you your wish, it is like, you will get that confidence to face the situation and get the power to get out of bad times. This happens based on all the combinations that happen around you.

If you think of your Job interview, when you attend it, if you want that job so badly, you will get the power to do well in it. When you are confident enough to crack the interview — In the end, you will crack it. I can say God lies in us i.e subconscious mind. This mind is driven by values and how we train it when we get the chance.

Visualization Technique:

When I was a child, my elders were asking me the question about the fastest thing in this universe, What can travel faster than light? How? After I grew up, I understood that question is the metaphor of telling the power of our subconscious mind. The answer to the question is our mind. How? Think of a place or Sun in your mind by closing your eyes. Within no time, in your mind, a picture of Sun comes in and tells your conscious mind that it has reached its destination. But, light takes 9 minutes to reach Sun from here.

One more instance is, when you let your mind to pain the nature through its imagination, you create the world probably that you are talking to animals and the world that is living in harmony and peach with all the living creatures. Like we see in movies. All the sci-fi and fantasy movies we created are just the projection of our subconscious mind that helped us to create all the creative works.

The sleeping technique:

When you are so tired from work when you close your eyes — feel that you are flying in the clear sky with wings — makes your mind to feel re-energized or even 20mins power nap will get back to the version of you where you feel like your energy is restored. When you are back up, all your negative thoughts will get wiped.

There are chances of being more positive when you wake up from sleeping than in normal time. Sleeping is like emptying your stack by popping out all the negative things in your life. When you are awake for a long time, that stack fills up and drips out of the stack. That stack dripping leads to build negative things in your mind and less motivated to work. Hence, the sleeping technique helps you to empty the tank of negative things and fill the tank of energy.

The thank-you technique:

It is required to thank good things that are happening in your life. I cultivated this simple habit to make myself feel better every day. I thank each one of them I meet in my day and greet them with a smile. When I ate food outside, I leave tips to the waiter guy & I smile at him by saying, “Thank you, buddy” at the end with his name. I don’t know what they might feel but I feel good about myself for thanking him. This keeps me grateful for life with gratitude.

How to use the power of your subconscious for wealth

This is very important made by the author in this book. Last year when I failed in my startup and gone bankrupt, I lost all the faith and hopes about starting new again and I was completely scared to tap into that risk again, still, I am. My helplessness kept growing in me all the time unless I took the stand to guide my mind as nothing happened. The point here is, when we get disappointed by something or when we face failure in life, we tend to give up and we think ourselves that we are not fit for that position. To grow toward that position, it needs a miracle.

Keep this in mind, the miracle is in you and you just have to know it well so that when you tap into your subconscious, you guide your mind to be like that. As long as you guide your mind that it is wealthy and it lost nothing, you keep on growing. When you provide the intent to your mind about you are growth, it always works for your growth. If you feel aidless or disappointed, your subconscious only amplifies those thoughts and respond to those feelings to be more sad or remorse.

If you want to be wealthy, keep reminding your mind that you are rich enough to do anything. This will grow those wealthy instincts in you.

I like money, I love it, I use it wisely, constructively, and judiciously. Money is constantly circulating in my life. I release it with joy, and it returns to me multiplied in a wonderful way. It is good and very good. Money flows to me in avalanches of abundance. I use it for good only, and I am grateful for my good and for the riches of my mind.

Repeat the above words at least twice a day and when you wake up and before going to sleep. This will build endurance in your mind. It will always keep you healthy. It makes your subconscious mind to respond to you with the ideas that work.

The lack of knowledge of the interrelationship of the conscious and subconscious mind brings marital problems

When it comes to relationships, acceptance matters. Acceptance from both sides is the primal factor for any relationship to hold strong for a long time.

The author suggests that the best time to prevent divorce is before marriage that is the reason most people try dates before marriage and getting to understand each other. As I have observed in relationships, people don’t show their true face until they feel enough with the same person. The love between tends to decrease as time goes on. Is it possible to love the same way eternally? I was haunted by this question for a long time. Being myself I tried to find out the answer to it but failed to experience it but I observed people around me fall in love and as time goes on their love deteriorated.

This can be prevented when we feed our subconscious mind with the fact about the person and our acceptance toward them. Sometimes we cam witness no matter how bad the person is, his/her partner still loves her/him unconditionally. This happens when we feed our subconscious mind with the love we thought to provide to the person we love.

By tapping into the subconscious mind we can make people stay with us forever or to stay away from us. This holds for every relationship. Why we love our parents that much or why they love us without any expectations? This is because we are bonded by blood and we consider ourselves as one no matter what. That is the power of family and love. It always makes us strong. Someone somewhere will always be there as your family to love you.

According to the author, this technique will help you attract the ideal husband:

  • Sit down at night in your armchair, close your eyes, let go, relax the body, become very quiet, passive, and receptive.
  • Talk to your subconscious mind and say to it, “I am now attracting a man into my experience who is honest, sincere, loyal, faithful, peaceful, happy, and prosperous. These qualities, which I admire, are sinking into my subconscious mind now. As I dwell upon these characteristics, they become a part of me and are embodied subconsciously”.
  • I know there is an irresistible law of attraction and that I attract to be a man according to my subconscious belief. I attract that which I feel to be true in my subconscious mind.
  • I know I can contribute to his peace and happiness. He loves my ideas, and I love his ideas. He does not want to make me over; neither do I want to make him over. There is mutual love, freedom, and respect.

To attract the ideal wife, affirm as follows:

  • I now attract the right woman who is in complete accord with me. This is a spiritual union because it is divine love functioning through the personality of someone with whom I blend perfectly.
  • I know I can give this woman love, light, peace, and joy. I feel and believe I can make this woman’s life full, complete, and beautiful.
  • I now decree that she possesses the following qualities and attributes: She is spiritual, loyal, faithful, and true. She is harmonious, peaceful, and happy. We are irresistibly attracted to each other. Only that which belongs to love, truth, and beauty can enter my experience. I accept my ideal companion now.

There are the 15 Highlights I wanted to share to summarize the book:

  1. The objective and subjective mind, the conscious and subconscious mind, the waking and sleeping mind, the surface self and the deep self, the voluntary mind and the involuntary mind, the male and the female, and many other terms.
  2. Your subconscious mind takes the orders you give it based upon what your conscious mind believes and accepts as true.
  3. If you think good, good will follow; if you think evil, evil will follow. This is the way your mind works.
  4. It is an interesting and subtle truth that the law of the subconscious mind works for good and bad ideas alike.
  5. We do not have two minds, the conscious and subconscious mind are merely two spheres of activity within one mind.
  6. Your subconscious seeks to preserve your life and restore you to health at all costs.
  7. If you inadvertently took some poison, your subconscious powers would proceed to neutralize it. If you completely entrusted yourself to its wonder-working power, you would be entirely restored to health.
  8. It is a source of power and wisdom which places you in touch with omnipotence or the power that moves the world, guides the planets in their course, and causes the sun to shine.
  9. There is always a direct response from the Infinite Intelligence of your subconscious mind to your conscious thinking.
  10. Any picture, which you have in your mind, is the substance of things hoped for and the evidence of things not seen.
  11. Wealth is simply a subconscious conviction on the part of the individual.
  12. The feeling of wealth produces wealth; keep this in mind at all times.
  13. The point here is that if you convince your subconscious mind that wealth is yours and that it is always circulating in your life, you will always and inevitably have it, regardless of the form it takes.
  14. Ignorance of the functions and powers of the mind is the cause of all marital trouble. Using the law of mind correctly, friction between husband and wife can be solved.
  15. As you think quietly and with interest in the qualities and attributes, which you admire in the companion you seek, you will build the mental equivalent into your mentality.

Try this:

  1. Assume a comfortable posture, relax your body, and be still. Get into a sleepy state, and in that sleepy state, say quietly, over and over again like a lullaby, “I am completely free from this habit; harmony and peace of mind reign supreme.” Repeat the above slowly, quietly, and lovingly for five or ten minute’s night and morning. Each time you repeat the words, the emotional value becomes greater. When the urge comes to repeat the negative habit, repeat the above formula out loud by yourself. By this means you induce the subconscious to accept the idea, and healing follows.
  2. Repeat for about five minutes to yourself three or four times a day, “Wealth-Success.” These words have tremendous power. They represent the inner power of the subconscious mind.
  3. Worried you will not wake up on time? Suggest to your subconscious mind before sleep the exact time you wish to arise, and it will awaken you. It needs no clock
  4. Forgive yourself and everyone else before you go to sleep, this will help you heal more rapidly.
  5. Sleep for at least 8 hours. It is essential for peace of mind and health of the body.
  6. Pray in the right way to attract the right mate for you.

Conclusion:

So we finally made it to the end. This is how we guide and tap the power of our subconscious mind. I have taken a few words from the book directly and also I read all these books to summarize myself using the Headway app. First I read the real eBook and later I use summary apps to make myself comfortable before writing articles like these.

Our mind has 2 cores to process on. One is conscious and another is subconscious. It is a multi-threaded operation. All of our automated tasks are sent to the subconscious mind to process like an Async task that runs on the background. According to the researchers, we are not using even 10% of the processing power. Rest 90% of the power lies in the subconscious mind where it is waiting to be tapped.

To tap such kind of power, we need to have good hardware as well. Better hardware means a good and healthy body. Health comes from the heart. When we sleep regularly at least 8 hours, exercise daily, eat good and work well are all the attributes that keep our body strong. As long as our body is good, we can handle any amount of power that is provided by our subconscious mind.

These words are from my experience. Productivity depends on our mental health and our mental health depends on our physical health. When we are good physically and mentally, nothing is impossible. 3 important factors of mind are Consistency, Focus, and Patience.

Reach the level of infinite power to break the bonds of the universe that we live in. We can literally uncover impossible things when subconscious meets conscious, subjective mind meets objective mind. Potential is, just keeps you out of your seats always.

title: The Power of 20 Minutes — Goldilocks Duration
description: Selecting a 20-min interval to get most of the things done, makes life easier than ever.
imageAlt: A small hourglass inside a simple circular arc of morning light, beside a pencil and one finished geometric block; focused intervals and the Goldilocks duration.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
I was obsessed with playing games and mostly FIFA from EA, I was very fond of and was playing every version of it. Once, I played continuously 24 hours to complete a career mode. Whenever I play, I was setting gameplay timings per half time for 20 minutes. That is the maximum time anybody can set for half time in FIFA games. I was wondering why it is 20 not 30 to play or why can’t that be 45 mins itself?

Let me take you to another example of 20-mins time. Recently, I started to meditate every day consistently. It has been 40 days since I started. Every day I try to do more and more but every session is not there longer than 20mins. That is the maximum time per session. (I am using Headspace app to be mindful)

One more instance is that I read many articles and productivity books, they say, to take a 20 min power nap in the afternoon. This leads to an increase in the productivity of the mind.

There are a lot of instances where we find 20 mins as the baseline for so many activities. We set our timers to get things done. It is very important to know, why always 20 mins is the baseline? What happens if it is 10 or 30?

I got this question when I was meditating and set the session to 20mins. Why it is 20? Why can’t I extend the session more than that? Is there any particular reason for experts to choose 20?

I went on to research the fact about how it works. There is a correlation between our mind and the body. Our mind has 5 different type of waves that works under different frequencies. Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma all these frequencies, has its own voice and mental state. When we wake up or commit to work, our mind generates a frequency and from changing one state of frequency to another it takes 20 mins — we call this time as Goldilocks time. This is not so short like 10 mins to work on something or not so long as 30 mins to spend on it.

When we wake up every day in the morning, our mind will be locked to 20 mins of alpha mode. Our brain works between 8Hz and 12Hz of frequency. This range is the gateway to our subconscious mind. Because theta waves are the ones that work in the subconscious mind and Beta works from 12Hz to 40Hz. Since alpha is between Theta and Beta, this range is called the gateway to the subconscious.

The common way to enter the gateway of the subconscious, is that 20mins which we are focussed to complete the task. This would be the time as soon as we are awake. We all know the power of our subconscious mind. It unlocks the infinite possibility and provides us the energy to do anything. The 20 mins what we plan to start the day, helps us to be productive because we communicated at the start of the day with our inner mind. Subconscious is the automatic mind and independent of our physical senses. It just keeps doing the task that it has been assigned.

The reason that doctors suggest we sleep for 20mins in the afternoon time is this. In that power nap of 20 mins, our mind will drop from Gamma state (Works at the frequency between 40Hz and 100Hz) to alpha upon deep sleep. As soon as we wake up, it will still be operating in the alpha stage for the next 20mins. By this, we can give orders to our inner subconscious mind to work better and stay focused on the things to be done.

Our style of work will become versatile upon the power nap that we take in between working hours. What if, we sleep more than 20mins? I searched for that process as well. When we sleep for more than 20mins, our mind drops to the subconscious level and further, it goes down to the delta stage (0Hz to 4Hz) which is the reason for deep relaxation. When we awake from that stage, our mind starts to work on the gamma stage by producing more adrenaline. When that transition happens, our brain becomes more disturbed and less focussed. Consider when you are moving on a train at the speed of 10KM/hr and suddenly it is accelerated to 200KM/hr, you will get disturbed and start to assume a lot of things. You don’t think straight. The same thing happens to our mind when we are awakened from the delta/theta stage to gamma.

This is where the 20min intervals help our daily activities and that is the reason it is always 20mins. Our brain is designed to transition from one stage to another in 20mins.

While meditation, the brain goes to the alpha stage from the gamma stage by opening a gateway to our subconscious mind. In there we can repair all the damages that have been done to our overall mind.

Try this: Whenever you wake up, try to set up goals for the day and don’t look at any digital equipments. Just take a deep breath and set up some goals and move on with the day. Within a day of two you will observe the change of productivity that happens at work for you.

title: Workarounds That Can Be Applied Out of the Box — Dynatrace
description: Here is the list of challenges that I have faced in the customer’s place this year 2019 and how I made sure to think out of the box to help them.
imageAlt: An ordinary paperclip becomes a clever bridge between two separated software blocks; inventive monitoring workarounds.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
The year started with the brilliance of my work and I was on high when everything changed in my life. I did face a few challenges to overcome and pushed into the job that made me learn almost every technology from being a developer, I taught to think like a DevOps guy, Consultant, Architect, and a Manager, I did few mistakes and my situation was all over me half of the year but It never made me forget my root — Innovation and Problem-Solving.

In this article, I wish to list out a few of the challenges that I faced and successfully solved them in the customer place. This is my professional journey of 2019. It is like a pill in Ibiza. Being a developer, I indulged to help customers as a consultant. My confession of the whole year is that If I go back and do things again, “I would love to do it more differently and dedicatedly.”

Honorable mentions, HPCL, IndusInd Bank and Zycus. Let’s take a look at the different challenges I faced,

List of Challenges:

  1. Dynatrace Mobile Application Configuration for Managed Installation Clusters
  2. Dynatrace Mobile Instrumentation for Kony Platform
  3. Network Metrics in Dynatrace Mobile Monitoring
  4. User Session Retention Period
  5. Node Balancing:
  6. Elasticsearch Streaming:
  7. API Reporting Using Dynatrace APIs:
  8. Synthetic Monitoring with Captcha (Proscript):
  9. RUM Automatic Maintenance:
  10. Kubernetes Offline Installation:
  11. Xamarin Mobile Instrumentation:
  12. Cordova Application Instrumentation:
  13. Solaris System Monitoring:
  14. URL Monitoring without Consuming DEM Licenses

Dynatrace Mobile Application Configuration for Managed Installation Clusters

When we implement Dynatrace in a customer place, we often forget to make Cluster Active Gate public unless we require it. It is recommended to make AG (Active Gate) public that is because it has its pros. It helps to monitor websites and check their availability around the world and the main thing is to get problem notification on the go. We need to make cluster AG public to monitor our mobile apps as well.

The challenge was, even cluster AG is public, customers were not able to get problem notifications to their mobile. There were 2 options in front of me to decide, I can integrate Slack to get notifications or I can find out the root cause and do it. I tried the first one and failed. Customers had partners who were taking care of their APM solution. What I had to do should be gone through partners. When I tried to Implement Slack, they laughed at me and made slack workspace fail. Hence, customers never adopted it. I only left with one choice now, i.e. to find the root cause and help them to get the notifications in Dynatrace Mobile App.

Dynatrace cluster is not accessible to outside their premises that was the root cause. I tried an idea that came to me as I have some experience about how mobile apps work to connect to the server hence, I downloaded the application and to connect their cluster, I connected to the customer’s WiFi network where Dynatrace cluster was also accessible and tried connecting mobile app to it. It got connected to their cluster. Now the problem is that the application is built to get notifications on the go. When a person goes out of the office, he will not be able to get problem notifications. But, guess what, he got notifications on the go! This is because, the application was getting connected at the start using beacon URL from the browser, when the network the browser is in, cannot access the cluster, the application was failing to connect to it. Upon first connection, the application receives the data through cluster AG that is made public.

Dynatrace Mobile Instrumentation for Kony Platform

As we all know in 2018, Mobile Instrumentation was just growing in Dynatrace. We were not supported officially. I worked on it to support it with conventional methods. Just instrumented it with the offline plugin and voila! Back to business. It got instrumented. this was the first production mobile application I instrumented and from that day I have helped to instrument around 25 mobile apps this year.

Network Metrics in Dynatrace Mobile Monitoring:

This is where I used my head more. The customer was happy with Dynatrace and they expected all the features of web application monitoring to be there in mobile monitoring as well. These customers knew AppMon and they needed to see the same kind of data in Dynatrace. I was new and was getting started to know about Dynatrace but I had my skills in Android development from the past 3 years.

I found out a workaround to convince them and at last they did not accept due to huge commercial involved. The problem was that they were not getting any data about Front-End Time, Network Time and Server Time. Mobile Instrumentation cannot detect those times as we were able to capture only front end time and web request timing in it. Here in this crisis, I found our Hybrid Instrumentation. It is better than auto-instrumentation and helps to have control over monitoring data. Hybrid Instrumentation is the combination of auto and manual instrumentation without affecting the auto instrumentation procedures.

User Session Retention Period

In Dynatrace, we can store the data of User sessions for only 35 days and thereafter, all the data will be truncated. To address this issue, I contacted support and they told me. “this is because monitoring made simple and storing user session data for longer than it is required is not a good idea. It just simply stacks up unnecessary information.” One way or the other it made sense to me.

But, in our customer places, they need to store the data for more than 35 days for example, in Bank sectors. There is a solution I found out to stream data to Elasticsearch and store all the data in the cluster. There is a limitation in Elasticsearch as well. There is a premium subscription required to store unlimited data and to process it.

To make this thing easy, I found out a workaround where we can have our own MongoDB instance setup in customer place and then we can store all the user session data in the database. This can be done through Dynatrace API. I created an API call to retrieve all the user sessions with the user actions for the given amount of time and fetch the data and store that data in MongoDB or Firebase. About this data, I have created a portal that can plot charts in a portal with the data for future analysis. The data retention period of this portal was unlimited. Hence, this solved the problem of data retention.

Node Balancing

In a Managed installation of Dynatrace, we recommend our customers to have at least 3 nodes to store the data including, transactional storage and non-transactional storage. Dynatrace runs even when there is one node. There was a situation in the customer place that they asked the reason, why dynatrace is recommending 3 nodes instead of 2?

Everybody suggested that to make sure there is a double safety upon cluster failover, Dynatrace recommends 3 nodes. When I searched for the answers with my team members, I have found out an interesting fact about it. We thought before that Data stored in all those 3 nodes are redundant and also stored as a backup to each other. The fact is, Dynatrace is storing dividing the data that it is storing in nodes equally. For example, if there are 3 user sessions, all 3 of them will not be stored in all 3 nodes. Instead, each session will be stored in each of the nodes.

Data is not a replica in other nodes. If one cluster fails, that means Dynatrace will have only 66% of your data and rest 33% will not be stored in nodes Hence, you need to set up a backup to store complete data. Your setup can have a maximum of 8 nodes depending on your requirement. The cluster can take up to a maximum of 3 failure nodes. More than 3 failovers can lead to the whole setup failure.

Elasticsearch Streaming

In our product, to stream user session data away from Dynatrace we have an option in settings to stream user sessions directly to Elasticsearch instance with the index value. The limitation of the feature is that you cannot stream data from multiple management zones. You can either stream the data of one management zone or all management zones.

Consider the situation. Elasticsearch instance is down due to some maintenance error for 30mins of time. Dynatrace continuously streams the user session data to Elasticsearch. At this moment, if Elasticsearch is down, the customer loses the data until Elasticsearch gets back running.

Currently, it is a continuous stream of documents with only a few retries before the exported document is discarded. So for a short interruption document will be retried after a short while and sent when it is available again, but if Elasticsearch and offline for a longer time, documents are discarded at some point with an admin-visible notification in the WebUI. The retry count is 3.

To tackle this issue, I built a portal similar to that of the User session retention period. In here, I call Dynatrace API to fetch all the user session data of the last 24 hours every day and store it in MongoDB or Firebase (Any JSON Database). This data I can feed it to Elasticsearch or my portal. The main thing is data is not lost.

API Reporting Using Dynatrace APIs

I call this workaround as the best one I ever did till now. Dynatrace reporting is amazing and it gives us the complete health report and it is generated automatically every week. In that report, all the data are shown as scores by calculating them as Application Score, Service Score, and Infrastructure Scores. In customer places, they needed more info like what is the average Host health, Number of sessions captured, Details of the problems that have been reported by Dynatrace among how many are service-based or infrastructure based? Which of them has the root cause? These are the concerns that they had.

To make Dynatrace better in those cases as well, I built a portal that contains reporting patterns based on the data sent by the customer like, If they provide their API key, Tenant details, Required metrics, Timeframe and the Scheduler duration the portal will directly start reporting to the customers with their specified metrics in the given time of choosing timeframe. Currently, it uses an excel format to send reports. In the future, it will have more capabilities like Business Intelligence and Visualizing reports along with an Issue tracker.

The development of the API reporting platform uses the Dynatrace API feature to receive data from the tenant. Every step is taken to ensure the safety of the data and it won’t be compromised to any third-party servers without a security check.

Synthetic Monitoring with Captcha (Postscript)

Synthetic Monitoring is one more feature in Dynatrace that always catches my eye. It is used to monitor URLs and Browser clickpath that monitors the availability of the URL in different locations all around the world and also we can use this in our own custom locations to monitor as well.

While using clickpath, if we encounter a login page and if there is any captcha verification on that page, the synthetic monitor stops right there and it won’t proceed further. To make this work we need to use Prescript and Postscript. We need to add an access token and this will do the job for us. In this case, the support team has helped us. This is a sensitive workaround therefore, only privileged members who have access can do this job.

RUM Automatic Maintenance

This one was the smart one for me. This uses the Dynatrace Configuration APIs. We don’t have an option in Dynatrace to schedule Real User Monitoring (RUM) to the apps. For example, if we want to turn off monitoring of the application in Dynatrace after business hours and resume it when business hours start, we need to manually do it every day and if we miss to turn it off, we lose licenses and if we forget to turn it on, we lose business data from the users. If we keep 24/7 enabled, there might be chances to consume licenses for unnecessary data.

My customer was worried about the process and they lost too many licenses and the data because of the human error. To minimize this, I did a simple workaround. I used Postman’s Monitor and Dynatrace Config APIs. I collected their RUM maintenance APIs, created 2 collections in Postman and added to monitor. One is to call an API with isrumenabled parameter to true and others to false. This sends a call to that particular web application to turn on/off RUM in the given time. Postman’s Monitor has that feature to set time and intervals to execute the API call.

Kubernetes Offline Installation

This is the recent query I got to answer. I had no idea about Kubernetes and how it works. Apart from knowing the term, I knew nothing about it. This assignment has been passed to me by one of my friends. I opted to help her and to work on it.

Installation of OneAgent operator in Kubernetes is a direct approach as per Dynatrace Documentation. As we all know ideal conditions are far away when we are in customer places. In their cluster, there is no internet. Without the internet, a direct approach is not possible because it connects to the red hat server to download the operator. To tackle this issue, I asked our support team. They insisted on a workaround to host the operator in their local repo and then pointing out to that location in the JSON file obtained in Dynatrace’s GitHub repo. So, download the operator, hosted in the local repo then pointed the location to that repository and later executed commands based that.

Challenge was hosting the operator in the local repo. We needed to tag the local repo with remote repo and then pushing all those files to the local repository. This task seems easy for experts but for a person like me without having knowledge and later after a week to pull this task off is a kind of satisfactory work.

Xamarin Mobile Instrumentation

This was a unique challenge for me. When Xamarin was launched, I was working as a student developer at Microsoft. I loved each and every release of Visual Studio and was obsessed with their technology. I explored Xamarin in its early stages and developed an app to learn Xamarin.

That really came in handy for Mobile Instrumentation. There was a project came up to instrument the Xamarin app. Nobody was there in my team to assist them with that. As my expertise exists in mobile applications, I was insisted to work on this small task of Instrumenta=ing Xamarin apps. When I learned to instrument these apps by myself, I found out that it is similar to iOS instrumentation. Need to add dynatrace.properties file to the root directory and rest is bug fixing and finding compatible third-party libraries.

Cordova Hybrid Application Instrumentation

The most challenging instrumentation I have ever faced this year. Our many of bigger clients are using Cordova. I heard about Cordova when I attended Tizen Dev Lab conducted by Samsung. I met a developer who has around 15 years of experience in the industry talking about cross-platform application development tools.

When I asked to take up the Cordova instrumentation, I had no idea how it works internally. I know only Android Instrumentation that too because I worked only on Android. I choose to ask our product team about it. After creating the sample application of Cordova in my local machine, I began instrumenting the application. I downloaded dynatrace.config from my Dynatrace tenant and added that file to the root directory of my project. The sample application was Instrumented but there was only native code was instrumented. Js code that is there in the project is not instrumented. So, I have created a web application and injected an agent to it. This instrumented web requests but not native requests.

There was confusion there. How to get bot the requests in a single application? Later I found out that while generating .config file from the tenant, we need to enable web monitoring and this injects the Js agent to the file. With the help of the config file, Cordova downloads Js agent from the tenant specified. This will instrument both native and web parts together. Still, we need to see the web requests in the web application version of the mobile app in Dynatrace tenant.

React Native Instrumentation

React Native Instrumentation is now official in Dynatrace but before 4 months it wasn’t. We had to use an unofficial version of the plugin found in GitHub. Recently, a customer with the React Native app came across and asked me to help them with the instrumentation. In the documentation of Instrumentation, there is no clear or direct information about how to create dynatrace.config file using properties. So, they used the same config file that is generated by Cordova Instrumentation. React Native config file is different from that file hence, I have created the config file of my own and supported them with that. Finally, Instrumentation was successful.

Instrumenting Mobile applications that have Keyboard

There is an International customer who builds a Keyboard for customers and that helps them to check their account balance right from the keyboard without opening their banking application. For these kinds of applications, if we do auto-instrumentation, it captures everything that the customer touch. This will become a key logger. To eliminate the possibility, we had to find a workaround. Manual instrumentation is not the best option because auto instrumentation benefits will not be there if we go with the manual.

There will be a lot of code changes to make and this is not the feasible way. Thus, we found a way to start the agent wherever the particular activity loads in the app. Upon closing that activity, Plugin stops capturing the data and send it to Dynatrace. So, stopped autostart of agent whenever application loads and started the agent whenever they need. Even this worked out for certain key clicks as well.

Solaris System Monitoring & URL Monitoring without Consuming DEM Licenses are the upcoming challenges that I am working on for the year 2020. These workarounds are demanding the best out of me and it makes me curious to know the product better.

Conclusion:

My mind is always out of the box and I never accustomed to working on conventional methods to resolve the problem. Due to my style os work, I took the hit from my top-level individuals and got a complaint that I am not fit to work and I am irresponsible. It is not how much we are disciplined to deliver the service. It is about how best we can deliver the service to the customer that makes them think more than conventional ways.

When Dynatrace itself ranked as a leader in innovations, why to follow conventional methods to stay in the race? we can be innovative as well as the whole company is. That is where we stand

title: 2020 Will be the Legacy of 2019
description: Life has been difficult when unexpected happened but still, hope got me back up.
imageAlt: Two unlettered calendar pages fold into a bridge with a seedling growing from the previous page; carrying lessons from 2019 into 2020.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
We are all at the end of this beautiful year. Also, the interesting fact about this year in Google is, the most searched term is, “India vs South Africa” in 2019. My most searched term is my name itself.

2019 has been the badass year of my life. It taught me a lot of things. It helped me to understand life. All it started with a bang of happiness with the most loved person of my life. I never thought that the person will not be with me while I am writing this article. We are separated for good. It has been the most painful moment of my life. Losing the person who I cared and loved the most in my life more than my parents, family members and devoted my complete self to the purest form of relationship called friendship. Few days before I sent that emotion to orbit out of my reach.

To explain my life in this article that I lived this year, you may need to join my journey here. This year has also invoked me to write a book called “Dummy District of Pain.” It is a story-based book and also this would be my first book when it publishes. I started this year with a party that I can remember for my whole life. I just wanted to celebrate the new year with my best friend and the most loved person of my life but, she disagreed and called one of our friends to join both of us.

Either way, the day was well spent and this was the best new year day I have ever had in my life. As this year continued, I earned the job of my own to survive. I and my best friend lived together and worked hard to get out of our survival problem. We didn’t have any sort of freedom to spend money with the ever-increasing debts.

After 3 months of the struggle, I came back from Mumbai to stay with my friend. We continued the journey and halfway through, she chose to go out of my life by finding herself someone to love. I was heart broke. After 3 years spent together, she decided to go away. This was the most painful moment of my life. Every day we lived together by not staying apart even for an hour. When the time came life took a new turn. She decided to go away literally. Technically she was present but when she choose someone, it made me uncomfortable to be with her and to love her in the same way that I use to live. Trust was broken and I got disappointed. I had nowhere to go and was just surviving my life hanging on to the last hope.

This made me homeless and I stayed in bus stops without food. I met with an accident and I was completely unfit to walk distances but still, I walked and held on to the hope that one day help may come. In my work, I was a failure and I had no place to switch on the laptop to work on when I was assigned to work. For being so honest and truthful, I nearly faced treason. That was agony.

One more painful moment is that I had no decent clothes to wear when I insisted to attend a client place. I had to lie to my manager that I am well even though I was homeless. I never told this story to anyone. I suffered hell and again with a glimmer of hope, I was taken back. From the luckiest person on this planet, I became the sorriest person to feel for. I suffered the pain physically and mentally with no one to understand. I was a person who cared for all the people around me but when this happens, my heart broke and made me feel what real life is. Still, my biggest regret is that I fought with my friend so badly that I slapped her and kicked her for doing like this to me — later she did the same and we called it truce though.

Seriously, it was very much painful to leave her. I loved her in every way. I treated her like my kid. We walked like one, we lived like one and earned like one for 3 years.

This incident made me strong inside. I went to commit suicide for losing hope in life. At the last moment, I remembered the people who are still there waiting for me. I felt like this is not the end of the world, this is just a small test and If I fail in this, what happens to the purpose of my life? I can help the people who suffered these consequences like me. It’s time for me to stand up and do something that nobody has ever done.

I was blacked out toward my goal. My expertise lies in coding and problem-solving. This is not it. I loved to write, teach, read, research in my childhood. Why can’t I start again? I love Photography, I love to talk in front of people. I was the top 1 student in debate throughout my schooling days from 1st to 10th class. What if I try to think like a 3-year-old boy? These questions I asked myself and to answer them, my mom supported me. She has been there for me forever.

I took a month to recover. It was like a holiday for me. The whole month I just let my emotions to govern me. As the days passed, my inner self didn’t let me be ruled. It gave me the control back to change my lifestyle. I just started writing, reading a lot of articles. Started #100DaysOfRead in social media. Learned Digital Minimalism. I decided to make small routine changes that helped me to become who I am now.

I started to meditate, read, write, exercise, walk every day. I started with writing my journal and listing out the tasks I have and I did throughout my day. At the end of the day, I listed 3 happy things that I encountered on that day. I appreciated the change that is happening in me. This gave me immense confidence to decide my future. I started to be mindful.

Still, now, I write a minimum of 1000 words a day and other activities I mentioned. All these things have become a habit for me. Almost 24 hours a day I keep myself busy by feeding my brain those thoughts that I love. Now, I dream about Physics and AI. I list out ideas in my notebook. I publish an idea every day as #100DaysOfIdeas.

All these activities cannot make me rich or famous. I am doing all these things myself. My goal is to bring change in human lives and help them to live life at its fullest rather than only survival.

For 2020, I resolve that at least I continue to write 1000 words per day on average and I want to complete my first book. Publishing 200 articles is not an insane target either. Important resolution is, I would like to learn Photography by traveling around. I would like to move my ass to different places by exploring all of the people and their culture. Earning money is an important part but not more than reinventing myself.

Life is not at all an easy ride. There are bumps and straight roads. To become a master of the game of life, we need to adapt stoicism. Let’s talk to ourselves every day and there is no other person who can back you except you. Just remember you are not alone, there is one more person always waiting for you, i.e. the other you in you (Subconscious). The subjective version of yourself always there for you. It all does the hard work behind you for you. So, love yourself and share that love with the world.

This is the part where I say that 2020 will be the legacy of 2019. I would like to continue the same habits that I have developed this year. I would like to conclude my letter to 2019 by saying, “May we meet again, buddy!”

Kindness, Compassion, Humility, Positive Disintegration, Health, Knowledge, Creativity and Focus are the nine aspects of our life which has the purpose that differentiate humans from all the species.
