I can say, freedom governs every law of the universe. As long as we have in control of it, it is our greatest companion. Otherwise, it can kill every relation around us.

Every outcome of our success based on how we think and thinking is originated from free-will. Better thinking makes us better humans and better humans work on knowledge, that can be preserved for Oxygen (Survival) to our future generations. If our brain gets more room to think, every knowledge on this planet thrive that helps to win our greatest fear.

Please join our mailing list for updates about us.

title: Knowledge
description: Persistent, Observable & Immersive attribute that mankind has ever known to respect
imageAlt: An open unlettered notebook sends a precise beam of light through a magnifying lens into small geometric stars; knowledge and observation.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Deep with our life, we survive, thrive and gain a lot of experiences that come from the moment we spend. In today’s PWG, I am going to take you on a small journey by talking about knowledge and its power. Every living creature possesses knowledge of its being humans, we explore the wider possibilities to gain it. We sail across the universe to feed our curiosity. Knowing is something different from exploring in which both provide us knowledge. There is an infinite resource to gain knowledge these days, the Internet, Books, Media, Networking are the major sources.

Richard Rorty explains in his book about the theory of knowledge and he beautifully compared it to the existence of philosophy in his book, “Philosophy and the Mirror of Nature” he says,

The eventual demarcation of philosophy from science was made possible by the notion that philosophy’s core was “theory of knowledge,” a theory distinct from the sciences because it was their foundation… Without this idea of a “theory of knowledge,” it is hard to imagine what “philosophy” could have been in the age of modern science.

He compares beautifully between modern science and philosophy in which without the theory of knowledge, philosophy can’t exist in this modern scientific world. Knowledge is power as long as we accumulate it daily. I was reading an article recently where a philosophic person reads an average of 1,000 books in his lifetime to keep himself down to earth with the vastness of available resources.

Knowledge comes from everywhere starts from your birth at the moment you start crying naked till you become naked at your funeral. We design our lives with the kind of knowledge we process in our minds. I saw many people who live for knowledge and others enjoy it. Gaining knowledge is not difficult and it is something you need to open your brain for.

Every living creature passes their knowledge on through generations of their existence in their way. Wild animals teach their cubs about how to hunt their prey, animals like Deer, they teach how to be fast enough so that they can escape from their predators. Being humans we write books, crave paintings, teach and draw characters to pass our knowledge to our younger generations. Either way, knowledge is infinite and there will always be so much to learn, We can either learn by inspiring ourselves to become predators or to become great escapists. It helps us to live and survive in this universe.

We usually divide knowledge in 2 forms, practical & theory in which practical knowledge is earned by experience and theory is the way we think of we learn from available resources. When it comes to the modern era, the vastness of available knowledge is extremely high compared to the old times. Different people acquire different kinds of knowledge. Starting from sociology, science, mathematical and philosophical ways.

Podcast by PWG, Voice by Varun Gn

Knowledge has dimensions, perspectives, and culture to deal with. According to the sociologist Mervin F. Verbit, knowledge may be understood as one of the key components of religiosity. Religious knowledge itself may be broken down into four dimensions:

  • Content: It varies from person to person.
  • Frequency: How knowledge occupies a person’s mind.
  • Intensity: Importance of the knowledge and the purpose to know it
  • Centrality: Tradition of the origin of that knowledge

The above 4D of knowledge helps every one of us to see through the depth of it and change the way we understand the possibilities.

It makes sense when we see our minds with the power of knowledge we have collected since the beginning of our life. Still, the fact is that we would be using not more than 10% of our capabilities and what our brain can do. As long as we train our minds to contain knowledge, we adore life. Lack of knowledge is not the absence of it, it means useless information in our brain where it cannot be used to any circumstance. No knowledge is useless until we find a way to use it and take advantage of it. We just need to focus on how to construct the information in the right place at the right time, this is called commonsense.

As research says, commonsense is inversely proportional to knowledge. Where there is more knowledge, commonsense will be less in that person but yet resourceful brains can handle both of them with a constantly called skill. As long as we have skills to control commonsense and knowledge, we can keep learning without any side effects from knowledge.

Knowledge = Skills/Commonsense

Every living creature possesses knowledge in the form of survival and to lead life. Being humans we construct ourselves differently than other creatures and expect to lead life differently from other beings. We have our Music, Religion, Culture, Behaviors, Languages, Subjects with all of them collided with a single entity called life. Knowledge exists to live and it is there for the survival of creatures. Exploring different possibilities makes us humans unique. We like to dominate the world may be with kindness, humanity or ruling but, the key is for everything is the knowledge. It is vast, it is unimaginable and it exists for a reason. The way we preserve gives life to it. Sustenance of knowledge and the true meaning of it is in the hands of humans. I can say, it is the most powerful tool to defeat anything in this universe. Power comes from different places so do knowledge.

Happiness is a form of knowledge and it represents the power artistically. We live to gain the power, the power comes from shared knowledge. It can only be encountered collectively as a team. This is where social living kicks in and from it, we discover new possibilities to live, there comes science and from science, calculation exists which makes life more curious to live. That curiosity starts religion. We should be lucky to see all 4 comes together to to form who we are.

title: Oxygen
description: Life and death depend on it. Power of Survival and Destruction.
imageAlt: A single breath-like ink wave passes through a simple leaf and around two open curves suggesting lungs; oxygen and survival.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Today I am going to write about the most important part of living creatures. The basic element for life to sustain and continue to live. Oxygen is an element in chemistry that has the Atomic number of 8 and having its chemical formula O2. Let’s move forward and work ourselves to know more about oxygen and how can we relate this to our well being.

Listen to the podcast with a different opinion, voice by Varun Gn

As we all know, plants produce Oxygen after photosynthesis and which helps our atmosphere to maintain the oxygen level. The primary component of living organisms to sustain is to breathe. We get oxygen from our atmosphere which helps us to breathe. Interesting thing is, Plants shits oxygen and also they breathe them as well. Trees and Plants do require oxygen to breathe as well.

Being humans, we cut trees to build buildings and to construct our homes, what happens if trees are not there? What happens there are only things which shit Carbon dioxide which is a greenhouse gas that is harmful to living creatures to breathe? Killing trees is almost like a suicidal attempt of humans to dig their graves.

Everything is pretty good up to this point but, oxygen is also a supporter of combustion which helps the fire to spread that is the reason recently, half of the Amazon forest burned due to fire this year, killing millions of living creatures. Anyhow, I want to talk about good and bad things now. Every important element in our life has both pros and cons of its own. I mean to say is that we need to see everything in the way it is by gauging good and bad in it.

Oxygen is the supporter of combustion, whereas solid Carbon dioxide diffuses fire. It is used by fire extinguishers. We need to see the advantages of the materials we use. Everything in nature is there for an advantage. We humans, with our evil minds, try to use it for destructive purpose leaving our humanity behind.

Just Imagine, what is the feeling we get when we hear the word oxygen? Calm, blue and pleasant. Whereas, If we remember the word Carbon dioxide, we feel it as evil. We understand the true nature of a substance by stereotyping it. This is not the way we can lead our lives, we have to stop looking at things as evil, there is always an evil inside us. As long as we feed it, it always wins.

This is the hard thing about hard things, being judgmental. Oxygen gives our life a purpose and the purpose is being pure and able to fuel our body with the right substance. As long as we keep all of our combustible things behind, we live, we can help others to live. Others are not only humans. Every living creature deserves to live in symbiosis with us. We are not a dominant species, our humanity is.

Plant trees more and more of them. Plant by the side of the road, beside your house, around your house, office, country side and everywhere. Living among trees, they are the perfect stressbusters and a true friend. #LiveSymbiotic

Please join our mailing list for updates about us.

title: Human Emotions
description: Small article based on the most important aspect of being human
imageAlt: A single calm human outline is surrounded by five distinct gentle ripples in muted colours; the range of human emotions.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
We all know how we manage our tasks every day. It is obvious for every human to be driven by emotion. All of the living creatures have emotions from fearing for death to self-defense impulse. We try to catch the most beautiful things in our life to the most horrible things. These impulses in our mind are governed by our emotions. Human emotions are unique from other living beings. We are packed with the superpower of being awesome and thinking about unthinkable. Imagination, Creativity, Compassion, and Humanity are the 4 things that govern our emotions to the extent of every level.

The beauty of nature is, Chicken feed the chicks by the heat of its body. Crocodile senses the birth of its child from egg even from underwater, Tortoise looks after its babies and feeds them with a look of an eye. All these wonderful mysteries have emotions inside of it. Scientifically we may not know how but, this is an absolute beauty of emotional beings. When we are in love we sometimes feel about our partner of his/her pain. Mother can feel her child’s heartbeat.

Our values define us where we stand and how well we perform in our difficult times. We try hard to control things that we don’t want to. Let me explain my experience over these emotions and how I got over it. Last month I was in an intense pain of losing someone who I loved the most. Due to some circumstances, I had to leave her. I felt completely lost, vulnerable to pain and had full of disappointments which made me blame the person instead of getting over my emotion. I tried hard and hard every day to forget all the memories that I had spent with her. Every time I try, I was failing to get over those memories.

The first week I was unpredictable with my behavior. I was getting angry for small things, fought for those which are not mine, kindled with my feelings of depression. I threw myself in the ocean of depression where my emotion always got over me. I knew this will not help me to do anything in life.

Here are the steps I followed to overcome my depression,

  • I gave myself to life
  • I let my thought control me
  • I ate as much as I can
  • I watched movies, TV series on Netflix
  • I slept long hours
  • I disconnected from the world

It took time for me to get everything under my control. Even after letting my life to take me away to depression, I had faith in me about getting back to myself. I leaped over it.

In life, we need to let our emotions to control us instead of forcing ourselves as not being control. As long as we defend without giving up, we lose control over the other things that matter. As long as I tried controlling my emotions and defending myself to get out of it without accepting the fact, I was drowning in the ocean of depression. I had to swim to become myself free from those clutches, I tried my way of giving up.

Everyday while I was in my deepest and the darkest time, I was telling myself, “It’s OK to be in this position. I am gonna get through this”.

After a month of this slavery, I started to get stronger inside. My instincts never let us be a slave for a long time. It started to push me back to normal. The first thing, I felt at that movement is a shame. I was ashamed of doing nothing and my life thought me to fight back. I didn’t know how or what I am gonna do to fight. I left with nothing except failure and laziness.

The natural human tendency is freewill. All of us need the freedom to live and follow our paths. We don’t like to be slaves for anybody even for our own emotions.

I used this method to fight what I was going through. As deep as my emotions took control, my mind started to feel ashamed about me. The revolutionary guy who was in me started to instruct me and told me to change myself to get out of the control of my emotions. I needed to think logically to do that.

I changed my routine like this,

  • Started to tweet what I feel every day
  • Thought about being consistent about the fact in whatever I blend in
  • Written Journal every day
  • Listed my goals and values
  • Listed my disadvantages in a sheet of paper every day no matter it is the same thing I am writing.
  • I started to read articles about the topic I loved and tweeted them on Twitter.
  • I started my hashtag to feel unique. (#100DaysOfRead)
  • I spoke with the ones who cared for me at least once a day.
  • I did exercises at least 10 minutes a day.
  • I stopped excusing myself for not accomplishing my goals.

Everything, I did was consistent. I didn’t tell myself how to do or what to do. My only concern about me was being consistent and being honest with me.

The steps I followed, was consistent and pure effort. I stopped excusing myself and started to take things my way slowly and steadily. Every day is a small change in me started to appear. By those changes, my life looked interesting and made me curious to learn about new things in life. Ultimately, for a month I lived like an orphan and got out of emotion strong enough to dominate it in my ways.

I made my emotion as my protector by becoming a slave of it. I started seeing how beautiful human emotions are. We are living in a perception that being emotional, makes us weak and miserable. The truth is, emotion often helps us to grow when we start to embrace it.

Humans are tied with responsibilities and those responsibilities go way deeper than we think in our life. If we think that looking after our-self is also a responsibility, things start to change in our life. That change is not because of the environment, it is in us. The power of the change in the way we look at things makes them beautiful.

We need to have our life in a way that inspires us. Just a little tip for those who are open to change, “Living in life, is way too easy if you start embracing negative thoughts of your mind. Accept them, live with them. This gives you an ability to see life in the way you always intended to.”

10 changes you can make in your life to control your emotions,

  1. Know your values
  2. Look at the brighter side of life
  3. Enjoy your little freedom
  4. Modulate your brain to adopt
  5. Compile negative responses to positives
  6. Live consistently
  7. Be a better version of yourself every day
  8. Smile at rejections
  9. Appreciate what you have
  10. Give credit for your small accomplishments

Humanity is limitless, you can find everywhere like an air. Only thing that is stopping you from being human is the way you think about others. Feel others emotion like you feel yours, find a reason to help people. Assist and be kind to those who worship you. Be valuable to those who hates you. Mark your presence in the world that always loves you.

title: Epic Friendships Exist!
description: Friendship is about influencing what’s good in you and how much you care for the person from an unknown origin
imageAlt: Two small figures on opposite ends of a bridge hold the same strong knot of rope; enduring friendship and care.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
In our world we have a lot of people to hang out with, we gaze hundreds of people in a day at work but still, we hardly know them and who they are. Overall there are 7.7 Billion minds on this planet to connect with. Even though we have such a large scale of uniqueness, we choose one or two to become our best connection where we share our stories, making them to be a part of us and sometimes, we love those minds more than ours. This condition of life is called Friendship. In this condition, time freezes, negative thoughts are persuaded by innocence, every outcome of sorrow will become a beacon of hope. We humans, observe friendship from a different perspective and consider it as the best way to communicate with the person with freedom.

Since we all know how good friendship can be in one’s life based on my experience, my side of the story about friendship is a little different from others. Ever since from my childhood, family members are my friends until each of them grown apart leaving our family nuclear. I had friends from school and college. Those friendships were never on the broader side and I never knew about the true friendship which is outside of my family. As a young boy, my perspective about it was more dominant. All of my friends were looking out for me, cared for me irrespective of what they were doing on my back, they all were like a family. Until I grow up, I had no difference for friends & family. They both were the same.

As I went to study my graduation, part of my life changed where my family split up on both sides (Mother & Father’s family). That time I had no idea of what this world might be and I am just exposed without the guard. My understanding of friendship was like it is similar to the family where friends don’t give up on each other, having each other’s back, helping in difficult times and more than that they don’t cheat on others part.

I was introduced to a guy in my graduation who was also my pre-university mate. I was with him as his family and treated him as one. Both together we had a great time in our college. We went to movies, bowling, visited places and spent money. That was the time of my life and the best company I had after my family parted their ways. I trusted this guy more than I ever trusted myself and been with him for everything by giving him support for the things where he considered me as the one and shared a lot of his kinds of stuff. Till this date, he is the only friend in boys who I trusted the most and had a hopeful thought about achieving big with him someday.

In our life, we meet people who remind us about what we stand for. Meeting with that kind of people help us to see our potential to take up life and work through it. The guy I mentioned in the last paragraph, taught me that. For having a great time with him for so long, I had to pay a price at the end. Everything in life comes for a price that we can’t predict what would it be while we are enjoying the company. This guy snatched the most valuable person of my life where it left me with agony. There was innocence, cuteness, childishness, beauty, loyalty, logic, love and epic friendship before he snatched everything from me for his selfishness. What he did is another story to tell, I just never want to remember that forever.

We trust our friends because, we have to in some circumstances where we left with no choice. When we have a few people around us, we trust nearly good ones but, those will become our worst nightmares when we find there are lot of good in this world.

This was the saddest part of my friendship story. Please let me know yours in the comment. In the next part, I tell you the best one(s). Few friends cared for me more than I cared for them. Those are unforgettable who helped my life to find a new path with exposure.

We can find friendships that are subtle and beautiful. I don’t have that kind of friendship at least now. There is a friend of mine, she is there with me from my pre-primary till now. There is a quote which tells about relationships, “The 7-Year itch”. It is a physiological term that suggests that happiness in a relationship declines after around year seven of a marriage. I heard this stands for all relationships and it quite worked out well in my life. The friends who stood by me for more than 7 years, are still there in my life caring for me. The ones who were not there, are not here.

We can’t determine a friendship by its duration, love between friends is more than that. It depends on how happy and how inspiring we spend time with them. More of the memories, stronger will be our bond. Connection with friends is determined by how sweet the memories are. If that friendship exists even after 7 years and you are still making sweet memories out of it, that is where epic friendship originates.

I believe 90% of friendships we find are not epic, they just make out, enjoy one’s company and leave. We know this world is moving fast and so does people moving out of relationships. We can hardly find that kind of relationship these days. I researched over a thousand relationships and friendships; they all seem to be perfect at the start and as days pass, dominance, ego, and self-respect take pride and that breaks everything in a movement.

My epic friendship is almost 20 years old now and we are still the same, childish, talkative and free-minded. We still those old memories from our childhood and also personal and professional outcomes. She cares for me more than I care for her. She had my back when I lost and helped me to get out of it. She also made me laugh when I needed to smile the most. Like her, I have a few other people where I can call them as friends and look out for me in my hardest of times.

Even after losing the person who mattered most to me by the guy I trusted the most, things went well for me because of the influence I made to some people. They trusted me and cared for me in my life and never let me down in anything. They often say how special I am to them but, they never say I am special because I have them in my life. This is where we find real friendships in our life. Those friendships are created by your influence on the people who admire your goodness of heart. As we move on with our life, we always tend to have bad experiences from less good people who consider themselves are having principles of their own.

Life never lets us choose people but, what we are making huge difference and influence we have on them inspire our relationship with them. Every individual on this planet is capable of friendship. Larger the circle we have with our good deeds, more influence we can have on them. This leaves us in a place where we are loved and it keeps us from negative effects from this world. We can be productive and make this world a better place to live with our passion for innovation.

The marquee fact of any relationship is the trust and once that is broken, you can never have it back. Everyone do mistakes but greatness remains in those who accept them and apologise for them. Gratitude present in greatness of life. Patience exist who have the power to forgive. Gratience is the key for a successful relationship.

title: A Poem of Family
description: Watched The Originals final episode followed by Vampire Diaries, watching these both series, I just understood quite well that family is power and that family comes from the people who we love and are near to…
imageAlt: Several interlinked circles shelter beneath the outline of a simple house roof, with a warm light in the centre; family, devotion and belonging.
imageCredit: Original illustration created for The Harithsa Notes.
html:
Watched The Originals final episode followed by Vampire Diaries, watching these both series, I just understood quite well that family is power and that family comes from the people who we love and are near to our hearts. Dedicated to Vampire Diaries and The Originals,

We go in search of words that defy ourselves,
we feed those paths in cross roads of fate,
finally we thrive in the middle of nowhere,
In search of our past that drags us together
In some kind of strange afflictions.

Humanity burns bad in us to be better,
with the ashes of bad, we reborn again for family,
this time our rebirth means something that is not
premonition, it is something which we call it as a
bond of devotion.

Sacrifices what we do to be together,
something always turns out to unleash
the power we see to be as healers.
Love is what binds us to make us stronger,
we loose it, we can’t stand for each other.

All of us share brotherhood to stand side by side
yet, problems will come to make us falter.
We are not the ones who give up,
everyday we stand together,
being united makes us who we are.

We vow each other to protect always and forever,
as deep as ocean and skies, as long as days and nights.
